title: Madhya-khanda, part 22 (portion 45)
html:
The section "Meeting with Sarvabhauma" (end): Kapoteshvara and the Bhargavi; the boy with the flute above the temple; Jagannatha stretches out His hands to the Lord; the Lord at Sarvabhauma's house and the first darshana of Jagannatha; mahaprasada and its glory; Sarvabhauma censures the Lord and offers to teach Him Vedanta; the Lord reveals to him the essence of Vedanta and shows the six-armed form; the author's word; the end of the Madhya-khanda

Disha: "Sing the sweet name of Sri Krishna Chaitanya — Gorachand! (murchha) Brothers, there is no other way to be saved: this story is rare in the world. As long as you live in the world, drink it, filling your ears; never give up the songs of His virtues!"1

তবে পুনঃ শুন গোরাচাঁদের চরিত ।
বরিখয়ে প্রভু প্রেমা নূতন অমৃত ॥ ১১২ ॥

tabe punaḥ śuna gorācāṁdera carita |
barikhaẏe prabhu premā nūtana amṛta || 112 ||

tabe punah shuna — now hear again; gorachandera charita — of the deeds of Gorachand; barikhaye prabhu — the Lord rains down; prema nutana amrita — prema, new nectar

112Now hear again of the deeds of Gorachand:
the Lord pours down a rain of prema — new nectar.

পথে চলি' যায় প্রভু নিজজন-সঙ্গে ।
দেখিল ত কপোত-ঈশ্বর মহারঙ্গে ॥ ১১৩ ॥

pathe cali' yāẏa prabhu nijajana-saṅge |
dekhila ta kapota-īśbara mahāraṅge || 113 ||

pathe chali yaya prabhu — the Lord walks along the road; nijajana-sange — with His own people; dekhila ta — saw; kapota-ishvara — Kapoteshvara; maha-range — with great joy

113The Lord walks along the road with His own people
and with great joy sees Kapoteshvara.

তারে নমস্করি' প্রভু চলি' যায় পথে ।
পুণ্যতীর্থ মহালিঙ্গ দেখিতে দেখিতে ॥ ১১৪ ॥

tāre namaskari' prabhu cali' yāẏa pathe |
puṇyatīrtha mahāliṅga dekhite dekhite || 114 ||

tare namaskari — bowing to him; prabhu chali yaya pathe — the Lord walks on; punya-tirtha maha-linga — holy places and great lingas; dekhite dekhite — looking at

114Bowing to him, the Lord walks on,
looking at holy places and great lingas.

তবে সে ভার্গবী নামে নদী ভাগ্যবতী ।
তাথে স্নান কৈল নিজজনের সংহতি ॥ ১১৫ ॥

tabe se bhārgabī nāme nadī bhāgyabatī |
tāthe snāna kaila nijajanera saṃhati || 115 ||

tabe se bhargavi name nadi — then the river named Bhargavi; bhagyavati — the blessed; tathe snana kaila — He bathed in it; nijajanera samhati — together with His own people

115Then comes a river named Bhargavi, the blessed;
in it He bathed together with His own people.

স্নান সমাধিয়া প্রভু চলি' যায় পথে ।
জগন্নাথ-মন্দির দেখিল আচম্বিতে ॥ ১১৬ ॥

snāna samādhiẏā prabhu cali' yāẏa pathe |
jagannātha-mandira dekhila ācambite || 116 ||

snana samadhiya — finishing the bath; prabhu chali yaya pathe — the Lord walks on; jagannatha-mandira dekhila — saw the temple of Jagannatha; achambite — suddenly

116Having finished His bath, the Lord walks on
and suddenly saw the temple of Jagannatha.2

চন্দ্রের কিরণ জিনি' উজ্জ্বল দেউল ।
পবন-চালিত তাথে পতাকা রাতুল ॥ ১১৭ ॥

candrera kiraṇa jini' ujjbala deula |
pabana-cālita tāthe patākā rātula || 117 ||

chandrera kirana jini — outshining the rays of the moon; ujjvala deula — the temple shines; pavana-chalita — moved by the wind; tathe pataka ratula — on it a red flag

117The temple shines, outshining the rays of the moon,
and on it a red flag flutters in the wind.

নীলগিরি-মাঝে হরিমন্দির সুন্দর ।
কৈলাস জিনিঞা তেজ অদ্ভুত ধবল ॥ ১১৮ ॥

nīlagiri-mājhe harimandira sundara |
kailāsa jiniñā teja adbhuta dhabala || 118 ||

nilagiri-majhe — amid the Blue Hill; hari-mandira sundara — the beautiful temple of Hari; kailasa jininya teja — outshining Kailasa in brilliance; adbhuta dhavala — wondrously white

118In the midst of the Blue Hill is the beautiful temple of Hari:
wondrously white, it outshines Kailasa with its brilliance.

অভিন্ন-অঞ্জন এক বালকের ঠাম ।
দেউল-উপরে প্রভু দেখে বিদ্যমান ॥ ১১৯ ॥

abhinna-añjana eka bālakera ṭhāma |
deula-upare prabhu dekhe bidyamāna || 119 ||

abhinna-anjana — dark as collyrium itself; eka balakera thama — the form of a boy; deula-upare — above the temple; prabhu dekhe vidyamana — the Lord sees plainly

119A boy dark as collyrium
the Lord plainly sees above the temple.

স-বসন হস্তে ঘন করয়ে আহ্বান ।
দেখিয়া বিহ্বল তারে করে পরণাম ॥ ১২০ ॥

sa-basana haste ghana karaẏe āhbāna |
dekhiẏā bihbala tāre kare paraṇāma || 120 ||

sa-vasana haste — with a hand holding a cloth; ghana karaye ahvana — beckons again and again; dekhiya vihvala — seeing, rapt; tare kare paranama — He bows to Him

120With His hand holding a cloth He beckons Him again and again;
seeing this, the Lord, rapt, bows to Him.

ভূমিতে পড়িলা প্রভু নাহিক সম্বিত ।
নিঃশব্দে রহিলা যেন ছাড়িল জীবিত ॥ ১২১ ॥

bhūmite paṛilā prabhu nāhika sambita |
niḥśabde rahilā yena chāṛila jībita || 121 ||

bhumite padila prabhu — the Lord fell to the ground; nahika samvita — unconscious; nihshabde rahila — lay silent; yena chhadila jivita — as if life had left

121The Lord fell to the ground unconscious,
lying silent, as if life had left Him.

দেখিয়া সকল লোক মূর্চ্ছিত-অন্তর ।
প্রভু প্রভু বলি' ডাকে না দেয় উত্তর ॥ ১২২ ॥

dekhiẏā sakala loka mūrcchita-antara |
prabhu prabhu bali' ḍāke nā deẏa uttara || 122 ||

dekhiya sakala loka — seeing this, all the people; murchchhita-antara — were stricken at heart; prabhu prabhu bali dake — call "Lord! Lord!"; na deya uttara — He gives no answer

122Seeing this, all the people were stricken at heart;
they call, "Lord! Lord!" — He does not answer.

কি হৈল কি হৈল বলি' চিন্তে গুণে তারা ।
কিছু না নিঃসরে যেন জীয়ন্তেই মরা ॥ ১২৩ ॥

ki haila ki haila bali' cinte guṇe tārā |
kichu nā niḥsare yena jīẏantei marā || 123 ||

ki haila ki haila bali — "what has happened, what has happened?"; chinte gune tara — they wonder anxiously; kichhu na nihsare — no sound comes out; yena jiyantei mara — as if dead while alive

123"What has happened? What has happened?" they wonder in alarm,
and no sound comes from them: as if alive, yet dead.

হেনই সময়ে প্রভু উঠিলা সত্বর ।
পুলকিত সব অঙ্গ প্রেমায় বিভোর ॥ ১২৪ ॥

henai samaẏe prabhu uṭhilā satbara |
pulakita saba aṅga premāẏa bibhora || 124 ||

henai samaye — at that very moment; prabhu uthila satvara — the Lord quickly rose; pulakita saba anga — His whole body thrilling; premaya vibhora — intoxicated with prema

124At that very moment the Lord quickly rose,
His whole body thrilling, intoxicated with prema.

দেখিয়া সকল লোক জীল পুনর্বার ।
মইল-শরীরে যেন জীউর সঞ্চার ॥ ১২৫ ॥

dekhiẏā sakala loka jīla punarbāra |
maila-śarīre yena jīura sañcāra || 125 ||

dekhiya sakala loka — seeing this, all the people; jila punarbara — came back to life; maila-sharire — into a dead body; yena jiura sanchara — as if life had entered

125Seeing this, all the people came back to life —
as if life had returned to a dead body.

তা-সভারে মহাপ্রভু পুছয়ে বচনে ।
দেউল-উপরে কিছু দেখহ নয়নে ॥ ১২৬ ॥

tā-sabhāre mahāprabhu puchaẏe bacane |
deula-upare kichu dekhaha naẏane || 126 ||

ta-sabhare — them; mahaprabhu puchhaye vachane — Mahaprabhu asks in words; deula-upare — above the temple; kichhu dekhaha nayane — do you see anything with your eyes

126Mahaprabhu asks them,
"Do you see anything with your eyes above the temple?

নীলমণি-কিরণ বরণ উজিয়ার ।
ত্রৈলোক্যমোহন এক সুন্দর ছাওয়াল ॥ ১২৭ ॥

nīlamaṇi-kiraṇa baraṇa ujiẏāra |
trailokyamohana eka sundara chāoẏāla || 127 ||

nilamani-kirana barana — of the colour of a blue gem's rays; ujiyara — radiant; trailokya-mohana — enchanting the three worlds; eka sundara chhaoyala — a beautiful boy

127Radiant as the rays of a blue gem,
a beautiful boy who enchants the three worlds?"

কিছু না দেখিয়া তারা কহয়ে দেখিল ।
পুনঃ মোহ যায় পাছে আশঙ্কা হইল ॥ ১২৮ ॥

kichu nā dekhiẏā tārā kahaẏe dekhila |
punaḥ moha yāẏa pāche āśaṅkā haila || 128 ||

kichhu na dekhiya tara — seeing nothing, they; kahaye dekhila — say "we see"; punah moha yaya pachhe — lest He faint again; ashanka haila — fearing

128Seeing nothing, they say, "We see,"
fearing that He might faint again.

পুনঃ তা-সভারে প্রভু কহিছে উত্তর ।
দেউল-ধ্বজায় দেখ বালক সুন্দর ॥ ১২৯ ॥

punaḥ tā-sabhāre prabhu kahiche uttara |
deula-dhbajāẏa dekha bālaka sundara || 129 ||

punah ta-sabhare — again to them; prabhu kahichhe uttara — the Lord says in reply; deula-dhvajaya dekha — look on the temple's banner; balaka sundara — a beautiful boy

129Again the Lord says to them,
"Look: on the temple's banner — a beautiful boy!

প্রসন্ন-বদনে পূর্ণামৃত যেন রূপ ।
আলোল অঙ্গুলি করতলে অপরূপ ॥ ১৩০ ॥

prasanna-badane pūrṇāmṛta yena rūpa |
ālola aṅguli karatale aparūpa || 130 ||

prasanna-badane — with a gracious face; purnamrita yena rupa — a form like full nectar; alola anguli — moving fingers; karatale aparupa — wondrous on the palms

130His face is gracious, His form like full nectar;
wondrously the fingers of His palms are moving.

আমারে ডাকয়ে কর-কমল-লাবণ্য ।
বামকরে বেণু শোভে ত্রিজগত-ধন্য ॥ ১৩১ ॥

āmāre ḍākaẏe kara-kamala-lābaṇya |
bāmakare beṇu śobhe trijagata-dhanya || 131 ||

amare dakaye — beckons Me; kara-kamala-lavanya — with the beauty of His lotus hand; vamakare venu shobhe — in His left hand a flute shines; trijagata-dhanya — the blessing of the three worlds

131He beckons Me with the beauty of His lotus hand;
in His left hand is a flute, the blessing of the three worlds."3

এ বোল বলিয়া প্রভু চলিলা সত্বর ।
আনন্দে চলিয়া যায় বৈষ্ণব সকল ॥ ১৩২ ॥

e bola baliẏā prabhu calilā satbara |
ānande caliẏā yāẏa baiṣṇaba sakala || 132 ||

e bola baliya — saying this; prabhu chalila satvara — the Lord hurried on; anande chaliya yaya — joyfully go; vaishnava sakala — all the Vaishnavas

132Saying this, the Lord hurried forward,
and all the Vaishnavas follow joyfully.

কোটি ইন্দু জিনিঞা সে গৌর-অঙ্গ-ছটা ।
ঝলমল করে সে চন্দন-দীর্ঘ-ফোঁটা ॥ ১৩৩ ॥

koṭi indu jiniñā se gaura-aṅga-chaṭā |
jhalamala kare se candana-dīrgha-phoṁṭā || 133 ||

koti indu jininya — outshining millions of moons; se gaura-anga-chhata — the radiance of Gaura's body; jhalamala kare — gleams; se chandana-dirgha-phonta — the long tilaka of sandal paste

133The radiance of Gaura's body outshines millions of moons;
His long tilaka of sandal paste gleams.

গোরা-গায় অরুণ বসন উজিয়ার ।
প্রাতঃকালে সূর্য জিনি' বরণ তাহার ॥ ১৩৪ ॥

gorā-gāẏa aruṇa basana ujiẏāra |
prātaḥkāle sūrya jini' baraṇa tāhāra || 134 ||

gora-gaya — on Gora's body; aruna vasana ujiyara — the reddish cloth glows; pratahkale surya jini — outshining the morning sun; barana tahara — its colour

134On Gora's body the reddish cloth glows bright;
its colour outshines the morning sun.

জগন্নাথ-মন্দির দেখিয়া গোরারায় ।
পুনঃ পুনঃ পরণাম করি' চলি' যায় ॥ ১৩৫ ॥

jagannātha-mandira dekhiẏā gorārāẏa |
punaḥ punaḥ paraṇāma kari' cali' yāẏa || 135 ||

jagannatha-mandira dekhiya — seeing the temple of Jagannatha; goraraya — Gora Raya; punah punah paranama kari — bowing again and again; chali yaya — walks on

135Seeing the temple of Jagannatha, Gora Raya
bows again and again and walks on.

নয়নে গলয়ে জল অবিরল ধারে ।
বিপুল পুলকে সে ঢাকিল কলেবরে ॥ ১৩৬ ॥

naẏane galaẏe jala abirala dhāre |
bipula pulake se ḍhākila kalebare || 136 ||

nayane galaye jala — tears flow from the eyes; avirala dhare — in unbroken streams; vipula pulake — with abundant thrill; se dhakila kalebare — the body was covered

136Tears flow from His eyes without cease,
and the hair on His whole body stands on end.

প্রেমায় বিহ্বল প্রভু হৃদয় সত্বর ।
উত্তরিলা মহাতীর্থ মার্কণ্ডেয়-সরঃ ॥ ১৩৭ ॥

premāẏa bihbala prabhu hṛdaẏa satbara |
uttarilā mahātīrtha mārkaṇḍeẏa-saraḥ || 137 ||

premaya vihvala prabhu — the Lord, overwhelmed with prema; hridaya satvara — with an eager heart; uttarila maha-tirtha — reached the great tirtha; markandeya-sarah — the lake of Markandeya

137Overwhelmed with prema, with an eager heart,
the Lord came to the great tirtha, the lake of Markandeya.

স্নান দান কৈল প্রভু যে বিধি আচার ।
চলিলা সত্বরে তবে করি' নমস্কার ॥ ১৩৮ ॥

snāna dāna kaila prabhu ye bidhi ācāra |
calilā satbare tabe kari' namaskāra || 138 ||

snana dana kaila prabhu — the Lord bathed and gave gifts; ye vidhi achara — as custom prescribes; chalila satvare tabe — then hurried on; kari namaskara — having bowed

138Having bathed and given gifts as custom prescribes,
He bowed down and hurried on.

যজ্ঞেশ্বর নমস্করি' অতি-হৃষ্ট-মনে ।
উৎকণ্ঠা-হৃদয়ে যায় সত্বর গমনে ॥ ১৩৯ ॥

yajñeśbara namaskari' ati-hṛṣṭa-mane |
utkaṇṭhā-hṛdaẏe yāẏa satbara gamane || 139 ||

yajneshvara namaskari — bowing to Yajneshvara; ati-hrishta-mane — full of joy; utkantha-hridaye — with an eager heart; yaya satvara gamane — goes with quick steps

139Bowing to Yajneshvara, full of joy,
with eagerness in His heart He walks on quickly.

পুনরপি জগন্নাথ-মন্দির দেখিয়া ।
পুনঃ পরণাম করে ভূমিতে পড়িয়া ॥ ১৪০ ॥

punarapi jagannātha-mandira dekhiẏā |
punaḥ paraṇāma kare bhūmite paṛiẏā || 140 ||

punarapi — again; jagannatha-mandira dekhiya — seeing the temple of Jagannatha; punah paranama kare — He bows again; bhumite padiya — falling to the ground

140Seeing again the temple of Jagannatha,
He bows again, falling to the ground.

অঝোরে ঝরয়ে দুই নয়নের নীর ।
বিহ্বল হইয়া কান্দে আরতি গভীর ॥ ১৪১ ॥

ajhore jharaẏe dui naẏanera nīra |
bihbala haiẏā kānde ārati gabhīra || 141 ||

ajhore jharaye — pour without cease; dui nayanera nira — the tears of both eyes; vihvala haiya kande — rapt, He weeps; arati gabhira — in deep longing

141From both His eyes tears flow without cease;
rapt, He weeps in deep longing.

এইমতে গোরাচাঁদের আরতি দেখিয়া ।
দেখা দিল জগন্নাথ পাণি পসারিয়া ॥ ১৪২ ॥

eimate gorācāṁdera ārati dekhiẏā |
dekhā dila jagannātha pāṇi pasāriẏā || 142 ||

eimate — such; gorachandera arati dekhiya — seeing Gorachand's longing; dekha dila jagannatha — Jagannatha appeared; pani pasariya — stretching out His hands

142Seeing such longing in Gorachand,
Jagannatha appeared to Him, stretching out His hands.4

আইস আইস বলি' ডাকে ত্রিজগত-রায় ।
দেখিয়া বিহ্বল প্রভু ভূমিতে লোটায় ॥ ১৪৩ ॥

āisa āisa bali' ḍāke trijagata-rāẏa |
dekhiẏā bihbala prabhu bhūmite loṭāẏa || 143 ||

aisa aisa bali — "come, come!"; dake trijagata-raya — calls the King of the three worlds; dekhiya vihvala prabhu — seeing, the Lord, rapt; bhumite lotaya — rolls on the ground

143"Come, come!" calls the King of the three worlds;
seeing this, the Lord, rapt, rolls on the ground.

আনন্দে হাসিয়া কিছু কহিল বচন ।
কৃপা কর জগন্নাথ দেখিল চরণ ॥ ১৪৪ ॥

ānande hāsiẏā kichu kahila bacana |
kṛpā kara jagannātha dekhila caraṇa || 144 ||

anande hasiya — laughing with joy; kichhu kahila vachana — He spoke; kripa kara jagannatha — be merciful, Jagannatha; dekhila charana — I have seen [Your] feet

144Laughing with joy, He said,
"Be merciful, Jagannatha — I have seen Your feet!"

পুনঃ না দেখিয়া পুনঃ করয়ে রোদন ।
পুনরপি দেখি' অতি উলসিত মন ॥ ১৪৫ ॥

punaḥ nā dekhiẏā punaḥ karaẏe rodana |
punarapi dekhi' ati ulasita mana || 145 ||

punah na dekhiya — not seeing again; punah karaye rodana — weeps again; punarapi dekhi — seeing again; ati ulasita mana — His heart greatly exults

145When He no longer sees [Him], He weeps again,
and seeing [Him] again, He is filled with exultation.

কেবল উদ্ভট প্রেম-পুলকিত অঙ্গ ।
হুহুঙ্কার-নাদে প্রেমামিয়া-তরঙ্গ ॥ ১৪৬ ॥

kebala udbhaṭa prema-pulakita aṅga |
huhuṅkāra-nāde premāmiẏā-taraṅga || 146 ||

kevala udbhata prema — nothing but wild prema; pulakita anga — the body thrilling; huhunkara-nade — with the sound of roaring; premamiya-taranga — waves of the nectar of prema

146Nothing but wild surges of prema, His body thrilling;
with a thunderous roar the waves of the nectar of prema rise.

তবে সেইমতে প্রভু চলিলা সত্বর ।
উত্তরিলা বাসুদেব-সার্বভৌম-ঘর ॥ ১৪৭ ॥

tabe seimate prabhu calilā satbara |
uttarilā bāsudeba-sārbabhauma-ghara || 147 ||

tabe seimate — then in the same way; prabhu chalila satvara — the Lord went quickly; uttarila — arrived; vasudeva-sarvabhauma-ghara — at the house of Vasudeva Sarvabhauma

147Then the Lord went on in the same haste
and came to the house of Vasudeva Sarvabhauma.

সার্বভৌম প্রভুরে দেখিয়া হরষিতে ।
গৃহব্যবহারে দিল আসন বসিতে ॥ ১৪৮ ॥

sārbabhauma prabhure dekhiẏā haraṣite |
gṛhabyabahāre dila āsana basite || 148 ||

sarvabhauma prabhure dekhiya — Sarvabhauma, seeing the Lord; harashite — joyfully; griha-vyavahare — by householders' custom; dila asana vasite — offered a seat

148Sarvabhauma, joyfully seeing the Lord,
offered Him a seat as householders' custom requires.

নমো নারায়ণ বলি' কৈল নমস্কার ।
রাধাকৃষ্ণে শীঘ্র মতি হউক তোমার ॥ ১৪৮+১ ॥

namo nārāẏaṇa bali' kaila namaskāra |
rādhākṛṣṇe śīghra mati hauka tomāra || 148+1 ||

namo narayana bali — saying "namo narayana"; kaila namaskara — he bowed; radhakrishne shighra mati — soon [your] mind on Radha and Krishna; hauka tomara — may yours be

148+1He bowed, saying "Namo narayanaya";
[the Lord replied,] "May your mind soon turn to Radha and Krishna."5

প্রভু-আশীর্বাদ-বাণী শুনি' ভট্টাচার্য ।
বুঝিলেন বৈষ্ণব-সন্ন্যাসী মহাচার্য ॥ ১৪৮+২ ॥

prabhu-āśīrbāda-bāṇī śuni' bhaṭṭācārya |
bujhilena baiṣṇaba-sannyāsī mahācārya || 148+2 ||

prabhu-ashirvada-vani — the Lord's words of blessing; shuni bhattacharya — hearing, the Bhattacharya; bujhilena — understood; vaishnava-sannyasi mahacharya — a Vaishnava sannyasi, a great acharya

148+2Hearing the Lord's words of blessing, the Bhattacharya
understood: this is a Vaishnava sannyasi, a great acharya.

সার্বভৌম দেখি' প্রভু কহিল বচন ।
জগন্নাথ দেখিবারে উৎকণ্ঠিত মন ॥ ১৪৯ ॥

sārbabhauma dekhi' prabhu kahila bacana |
jagannātha dekhibāre utkaṇṭhita mana || 149 ||

sarvabhauma dekhi — seeing Sarvabhauma; prabhu kahila vachana — the Lord spoke; jagannatha dekhibare — to see Jagannatha; utkanthita mana — the heart longs

149The Lord said to Sarvabhauma,
"I long to see Jagannatha.

কেমনে দেখিব আমি দেব-দেব-রায় ।
সাক্ষাৎ করিতে মোর সম্ভ্রম হিয়ায় ॥ ১৫০ ॥

kemane dekhiba āmi deba-deba-rāẏa |
sākṣāt karite mora sambhrama hiẏāẏa || 150 ||

kemane dekhiba ami — how shall I see; deva-deva-raya — the Lord, God of gods; sakshat karite — to meet face to face; mora sambhrama hiyaya — there is awe in My heart

150How shall I see the Lord, the God of gods?
To stand before Him — My heart is in awe."

এ বোল শুনিয়া সার্বভৌম মহাশয় ।
প্রভু-অঙ্গ নিরখিয়ে বিস্মিত-হিয়ায় ॥ ১৫১ ॥

e bola śuniẏā sārbabhauma mahāśaẏa |
prabhu-aṅga nirakhiẏe bismita-hiẏāẏa || 151 ||

e bola shuniya — hearing this; sarvabhauma mahashaya — the venerable Sarvabhauma; prabhu-anga nirakhiye — gazes at the Lord's form; vismita-hiyaya — with an amazed heart

151Hearing this, the venerable Sarvabhauma
gazes in wonder at the Lord's form:

এ তপ্তকাঞ্চন গৌর সুমেরুসুন্দর ।
নয়নচন্দ্রিমা মুখ করে ঝলমল ॥ ১৫২ ॥

e taptakāñcana gaura sumerusundara |
naẏanacandrimā mukha kare jhalamala || 152 ||

e tapta-kanchana gaura — He is golden like molten gold; sumeru-sundara — beautiful as Sumeru; nayana-chandrima mukha — the face, a moon with eyes; kare jhalamala — shines

152"He is golden like molten gold, beautiful as Sumeru;
His face, a moon with lovely eyes, is shining.

সিংহগ্রীব, কম্বুকণ্ঠ, সুদীর্ঘলোচন ।
আজানুলম্বিত ভুজ — সব সুলক্ষণ ॥ ১৫৩ ॥

siṃhagrība, kambukaṇṭha, sudīrghalocana |
ājānulambita bhuja — saba sulakṣaṇa || 153 ||

simha-griva — a lion's neck; kambu-kantha — a conch-like throat; sudirgha-lochana — long eyes; ajanu-lambita bhuja — arms reaching the knees; saba sulakshana — all auspicious marks

153A lion's neck, a conch-like throat, long eyes,
arms reaching to the knees — all auspicious marks."

উজ্জ্বল কৃষ্ণের প্রেমায় আরতি-বিহ্বল ।
পুলকে আকুল অঙ্গ করে টলমল ॥ ১৫৩+১ ॥

ujjbala kṛṣṇera premāẏa ārati-bihbala |
pulake ākula aṅga kare ṭalamala || 153+1 ||

ujjvala krishnera premaya — in bright prema for Krishna; arati-vihvala — overcome with longing; pulake akula anga — the body flooded with thrill; kare talamala — sways

153+1In bright prema for Krishna He is overcome with longing,
thrilling all over, His body sways.6

দেখিয়া বিহ্বল সার্বভৌম ভট্টাচার্য ।
গুণিতে লাগিলা দেখি' সকল আশ্চর্য ॥ ১৫৪ ॥

dekhiẏā bihbala sārbabhauma bhaṭṭācārya |
guṇite lāgilā dekhi' sakala āścarya || 154 ||

dekhiya vihvala — seeing, overwhelmed; sarvabhauma bhattacharya — Sarvabhauma Bhattacharya; gunite lagila — began to ponder; dekhi sakala ashcharya — seeing all the wonders

154Seeing this, Sarvabhauma Bhattacharya, overwhelmed,
began to ponder, seeing all these wonders:

এরূপ মানুষ নাহি সকল জগতে ।
দেবতা-ভিতরে ইহা না পারি গণিতে ॥ ১৫৫ ॥

erūpa mānuṣa nāhi sakala jagate |
debatā-bhitare ihā nā pāri gaṇite || 155 ||

erupa manusha nahi — there is no such man; sakala jagate — in all the world; devata-bhitare — among the gods; iha na pari ganite — I cannot count Him

155"There is no such man in all the world;
not even among the gods can I place Him.

বৈকুণ্ঠনায়ক প্রভু আইলা আপনে ।
এই সেই ভগবান্ বুঝি অনুমানে ॥ ১৫৬ ॥

baikuṇṭhanāẏaka prabhu āilā āpane |
ei sei bhagabān bujhi anumāne || 156 ||

vaikuntha-nayaka prabhu — the Lord, master of Vaikuntha; aila apane — has come Himself; ei sei bhagavan — this is that Bhagavan; bujhi anumane — I understand by inference

156The Lord of Vaikuntha has come Himself:
this is that Bhagavan — so I conclude."

এতেক চিন্তিয়া সার্বভৌম মহাজন ।
আপন তনুজ দেখি' কহিছে বচন ॥ ১৫৭ ॥

eteka cintiẏā sārbabhauma mahājana |
āpana tanuja dekhi' kahiche bacana || 157 ||

eteka chintiya — thinking thus; sarvabhauma mahajana — the great Sarvabhauma; apana tanuja dekhi — seeing his own son; kahichhe vachana — says

157Thinking thus, the great Sarvabhauma,
seeing his son, says to him:7

সত্বরে চলহ তুমি চৈতন্য-সংহতি ।
সাবধানে শুনিবে যে কহে মহামতি ॥ ১৫৮ ॥

satbare calaha tumi caitanya-saṃhati |
sābadhāne śunibe ye kahe mahāmati || 158 ||

satvare chalaha tumi — go quickly; chaitanya-samhati — with Chaitanya; savadhane shunibe — listen carefully; ye kahe mahamati — to what the great soul says

158"Go quickly with Chaitanya;
listen carefully to what this great soul says.

শ্রীজগন্নাথ মহাপ্রভু যথা আছে ।
সঙ্গতি-সহিতে ইহায় থোবে তাঁর কাছে ॥ ১৫৯ ॥

śrījagannātha mahāprabhu yathā āche |
saṅgati-sahite ihāẏa thobe tāṁra kāche || 159 ||

shri-jagannatha mahaprabhu — Sri Jagannatha Mahaprabhu; yatha achhe — where He is; sangati-sahite — with the companions; ihaya thobe tanra kachhe — place Him near Him

159Where Sri Jagannatha Mahaprabhu dwells —
take Him with His companions there, to Him."

এ বোল শুনিয়া তুষ্ট হৈলা গোরারায় ।
চলিলা ত সার্বভৌম-তনুজ-সহায় ॥ ১৬০ ॥

e bola śuniẏā tuṣṭa hailā gorārāẏa |
calilā ta sārbabhauma-tanuja-sahāẏa || 160 ||

e bola shuniya — hearing this; tushta haila goraraya — Gora Raya was pleased; chalila ta — went; sarvabhauma-tanuja-sahaya — with Sarvabhauma's son as guide

160Hearing this, Gora Raya was pleased
and went, guided by Sarvabhauma's son.

সিংহদ্বারে গিয়া প্রভু তনু টলমল ।
ধরিতে না পারে অঙ্গ প্রেমায় বিহ্বল ॥ ১৬১ ॥

siṃhadbāre giẏā prabhu tanu ṭalamala |
dharite nā pāre aṅga premāẏa bihbala || 161 ||

simha-dvare giya — coming to the Lion Gate; prabhu tanu talamala — the Lord's body swayed; dharite na pare anga — cannot hold up His body; premaya vihvala — overwhelmed with prema

161At the Lion Gate the Lord's body swayed:
rapt in prema, He cannot keep on His feet.

থির চলিবারে নারে আউলাইল অঙ্গ ।
সাবধানে কাছে কাছে যায় সব সঙ্গ ॥ ১৬২ ॥

thira calibāre nāre āulāila aṅga |
sābadhāne kāche kāche yāẏa saba saṅga || 162 ||

thira chalibare nare — cannot walk steadily; aulaila anga — the limbs went limp; savadhane kachhe kachhe — carefully, close by; yaya saba sanga — all the companions go

162He cannot walk steadily, His limbs have gone limp;
all the companions walk carefully close beside Him.

অনেক যতনে সিংহদ্বারে প্রবেশিলা ।
সেখানে ত্বরিতে নাটমন্দিরে উঠিলা ॥ ১৬৩ ॥

aneka yatane siṃhadbāre prabeśilā |
sekhāne tbarite nāṭamandire uṭhilā || 163 ||

aneka yatane — with great effort; simha-dvare praveshila — entered the Lion Gate; sekhane tvarite — there at once; nata-mandire uthila — went up into the Nata-mandira

163With great effort He entered the Lion Gate
and at once hurried up into the Nata-mandira.

গরুড়ের পাছে রহি' থির-দিঠে চায় ।
দেখিল শ্রীমুখচন্দ্র ত্রিজগত-রায় ॥ ১৬৪ ॥

garuṛera pāche rahi' thira-diṭhe cāẏa |
dekhila śrīmukhacandra trijagata-rāẏa || 164 ||

garudera pachhe rahi — standing behind Garuda; thira-dithe chaya — gazes steadily; dekhila shri-mukha-chandra — saw the moon-face; trijagata-raya — of the King of the three worlds

164Standing behind Garuda, He gazes intently —
and saw the moon-face of the King of the three worlds.8

অতি-উলসিত হিয়া ভরল আনন্দ ।
অঙ্গ আচ্ছাদিল ঘন পুলক-কদম্ব ॥ ১৬৫ ॥

ati-ulasita hiẏā bharala ānanda |
aṅga ācchādila ghana pulaka-kadamba || 165 ||

ati-ulasita hiya — the heart leapt up; bharala ananda — filled with bliss; anga achchhadila — covered the body; ghana pulaka-kadamba — dense thrills like kadamba blossoms

165His heart leapt up, filled with bliss;
His body was covered with thrills, like a kadamba blossom.

সাত পাঁচ ধারা বহে নয়নের জল ।
আপনা পাসরে প্রেমানন্দ-পরবল ॥ ১৬৬ ॥

sāta pāṁca dhārā bahe naẏanera jala |
āpanā pāsare premānanda-parabala || 166 ||

sata pancha dhara — in seven, five streams; bahe nayanera jala — the tears flow from the eyes; apana pasare — He forgets Himself; premananda-parabala — overpowered by the bliss of prema

166Five, seven streams of tears flow from His eyes;
He forgot Himself, overpowered by the bliss of prema.

ভূমিতে পড়িলা প্রভু অবশ শ্রীঅঙ্গ ।
বাতাসে খসিলা যেন সুমেরুর শৃঙ্গ ॥ ১৬৭ ॥

bhūmite paṛilā prabhu abaśa śrīaṅga |
bātāse khasilā yena sumerura śṛṅga || 167 ||

bhumite padila prabhu — the Lord fell to the ground; abasha shri-anga — His body helpless; vatase khasila — toppled by the wind; yena sumerura shringa — like a peak of Sumeru

167The Lord fell to the ground, His body helpless —
as if the wind had toppled a peak of Sumeru.

প্রেমার আবেশে মূর্চ্ছা হৈলা ভগবান্ ।
দুই হস্ত দৃঢ়মুষ্টি মুদ্রিত-নয়ান ॥ ১৬৮ ॥

premāra ābeśe mūrcchā hailā bhagabān |
dui hasta dṛṛhamuṣṭi mudrita-naẏāna || 168 ||

premara aveshe — in the rapture of prema; murchchha haila bhagavan — Bhagavan fainted; dui hasta dridha-mushti — both hands tightly clenched; mudrita-nayana — eyes closed

168In the rapture of prema Bhagavan fainted:
both hands clenched tight in fists, eyes closed.

শিথিল বসন ভেল বিবশ শরীরে ।
দেখি' দ্বিজগণ গেলা দেউল-বাহিরে ॥ ১৬৮+১ ॥

śithila basana bhela bibaśa śarīre |
dekhi' dbijagaṇa gelā deula-bāhire || 168+1 ||

shithila vasana bhela — the cloth came loose; vibasha sharire — on the senseless body; dekhi dvijagana — seeing this, the brahmanas; gela deula-bahire — went out of the temple

168+1His cloth slipped on His senseless body;
seeing this, the brahmanas went out of the temple.

আসন ছাড়িয়া জগন্নাথ প্রভু তুলি' ।
দোঁহার পরশে দোঁহে ভেল কুতুহলী ॥ ১৬৮+২ ॥

āsana chāṛiẏā jagannātha prabhu tuli' |
doṁhāra paraśe doṁhe bhela kutuhalī || 168+2 ||

asana chhadiya — leaving the throne; jagannatha prabhu tuli — Jagannatha, lifting the Lord; donhara parashe — at each other's touch; donhe bhela kutuhali — both were delighted

168+2Leaving His throne, Lord Jagannatha lifted [Him] up;
at each other's touch both were filled with delight.

বাহু বাহু দিয়া সে তখনি কৈল কোলে ।
জগন্নাথ-সম্মুখে নাচয়ে হরিবোলে ॥ ১৬৮+৩ ॥

bāhu bāhu diẏā se takhani kaila kole |
jagannātha-sammukhe nācaẏe haribole || 168+3 ||

bahu bahu diya — putting arms around; se takhani kaila kole — at once embraced; jagannatha-sammukhe — before Jagannatha; nachaye haribole — dances crying "Haribol"

168+3Putting His arms around [Him], He at once embraced Him,
and [the Lord] dances before Jagannatha, crying "Haribol!"

গৌরাঙ্গ-পরশে জগন্নাথ প্রেমে ভোরা ।
আসন-উপরে তবে বসাইলা গোরা ॥ ১৬৮+৪ ॥

gaurāṅga-paraśe jagannātha preme bhorā |
āsana-upare tabe basāilā gorā || 168+4 ||

gauranga-parashe — at Gauranga's touch; jagannatha preme bhora — Jagannatha intoxicated with prema; asana-upare — on the throne; tabe basaila gora — then seated Gora

168+4At Gauranga's touch Jagannatha, intoxicated with prema,
seated Gora upon His throne.9

নাচে হরি বলি' প্রভু শচীর নন্দন ।
প্রবিষ্ট হইলা সভে মন্দিরে তখন ॥ ১৬৯ ॥

nāce hari bali' prabhu śacīra nandana |
prabiṣṭa hailā sabhe mandire takhana || 169 ||

nache hari bali — dances crying "Hari"; prabhu shachira nandana — the Lord, the son of Shachi; pravishta haila sabhe — all entered; mandire takhana — the temple then

169The son of Shachi dances, crying "Hari!" —
and then all entered the temple.

গদাধর নাচে, নরহরি, নিত্যানন্দ ।
শ্রীনিবাস, দামোদর, মুরারি, মুকুন্দ ॥ ১৭০ ॥

gadādhara nāce, narahari, nityānanda |
śrīnibāsa, dāmodara, murāri, mukunda || 170 ||

gadadhara nache — Gadadhara dances; narahari, nityananda — Narahari, Nityananda; shrinivasa, damodara, murari, mukunda — Srinivasa, Damodara, Murari, Mukunda

170Gadadhara dances, and Narahari, Nityananda,
Srinivasa, Damodara, Murari, Mukunda;

আর সব ভক্তগণ নাচয়ে হরিষে ।
রাধাকানু-গুণগান কীর্তন প্রকাশে ॥ ১৭১ ॥

āra saba bhaktagaṇa nācaẏe hariṣe |
rādhākānu-guṇagāna kīrtana prakāśe || 171 ||

ara saba bhakta-gana — and all the other devotees; nachaye harishe — dance in joy; radha-kanu-guna-gana — singing the virtues of Radha and Kanu; kirtana prakashe — manifest in kirtana

171all the other devotees too dance in joy,
making kirtana, singing the virtues of Radha and Kanu.

তবে সভে অনুমানি' সঙ্গী যত জন ।
প্রভু লঞা আইলা সার্বভৌমের আশ্রম ॥ ১৭২ ॥

tabe sabhe anumāni' saṅgī yata jana |
prabhu lañā āilā sārbabhaumera āśrama || 172 ||

tabe sabhe anumani — then all, having considered; sangi yata jana — all the companions; prabhu lanya aila — brought the Lord; sarvabhaumera ashrama — to Sarvabhauma's dwelling

172Then all the companions, after deliberating,
brought the Lord to Sarvabhauma's house.10

সার্বভৌম-ঘরে প্রভুর সম্বেদন হৈল ।
গুণ-সঙ্কীর্তনে পুনঃ নাচিতে লাগিল ॥ ১৭৩ ॥

sārbabhauma-ghare prabhura sambedana haila |
guṇa-saṅkīrtane punaḥ nācite lāgila || 173 ||

sarvabhauma-ghare — in Sarvabhauma's house; prabhura samvedana haila — the Lord regained consciousness; guna-sankirtane — in the kirtana of virtues; punah nachite lagila — began to dance again

173In Sarvabhauma's house the Lord came to Himself
and began to dance again in the kirtana of [Krishna's] virtues.

দেখি' সার্বভৌম বাসুদেব ভট্টাচার্য ।
হৃদয়ে আহ্লাদ মহা দেখিয়া আশ্চর্য ॥ ১৭৪ ॥

dekhi' sārbabhauma bāsudeba bhaṭṭācārya |
hṛdaẏe āhlāda mahā dekhiẏā āścarya || 174 ||

dekhi — seeing; sarvabhauma vasudeva bhattacharya — Sarvabhauma Vasudeva Bhattacharya; hridaye ahlada maha — great delight in the heart; dekhiya ashcharya — seeing the wonder

174Seeing this, Sarvabhauma Vasudeva Bhattacharya
felt great delight in his heart, seeing this wonder.

তবে পুনঃ মহাপ্রভু-নৃত্য-অবসানে ।
ভিক্ষা-আমন্ত্রণ তাঁরে দিল সার্বভৌমে ॥ ১৭৫ ॥

tabe punaḥ mahāprabhu-nṛtya-abasāne |
bhikṣā-āmantraṇa tāṁre dila sārbabhaume || 175 ||

tabe punah — then; mahaprabhu-nritya-avasane — when Mahaprabhu's dance was over; bhiksha-amantrana tanre dila — invited Him to accept alms; sarvabhaume — Sarvabhauma

175When Mahaprabhu's dancing was over,
Sarvabhauma invited Him to accept alms.

প্রসাদ আনিতে দিল ব্রাহ্মণের গণ ।
প্রভু-সঙ্গে সার্বভৌম করয়ে মিলন ॥ ১৭৬ ॥

prasāda ānite dila brāhmaṇera gaṇa |
prabhu-saṅge sārbabhauma karaẏe milana || 176 ||

prasada anite dila — sent to bring prasada; brahmanera gana — the brahmanas; prabhu-sange — with the Lord; sarvabhauma karaye milana — Sarvabhauma converses

176He sent brahmanas to bring prasada,
and he, Sarvabhauma, converses with the Lord.

ইষ্টগোষ্ঠী করে বিদ্যা জানিবার তরে ।
তত্ত্ব জিজ্ঞাসিতে কিছু লাগিল প্রভুরে ॥ ১৭৭ ॥

iṣṭagoṣṭhī kare bidyā jānibāra tare |
tattba jijñāsite kichu lāgila prabhure || 177 ||

ishtagoshthi kare — holds friendly talk; vidya janibara tare — to learn [His] learning; tattva jijnasite kichhu — to ask about facts; lagila prabhure — began [to ask] the Lord

177He holds a friendly conversation to learn His learning
and began to ask the Lord something about Himself:

তোর জন্মস্থান কোথা কহিবে আমারে ।
প্রভু কহে যে কহিলে সেই সত্য হয়ে ॥ ১৭৮ ॥

tora janmasthāna kothā kahibe āmāre |
prabhu kahe ye kahile sei satya haẏe || 178 ||

tora janmasthana kotha — where is Your birthplace; kahibe amare — tell me; prabhu kahe — the Lord says; ye kahile sei satya haye — what you said is true

178"Where were You born? Tell me."
The Lord says, "What you have said is true."

ভট্টাচার্য কহে তুমি কি কহ কথন ।
এক কহি আর কহ কিসের কারণ ॥ ১৭৯ ॥

bhaṭṭācārya kahe tumi ki kaha kathana |
eka kahi āra kaha kisera kāraṇa || 179 ||

bhattacharya kahe — the Bhattacharya says; tumi ki kaha kathana — what are You saying; eka kahi — I say one thing; ara kaha — You say another; kisera karana — why

179The Bhattacharya says, "What are You saying?
I say one thing and You another — why?"

প্রভু মৌনী হই' রহে সমুদ্র-গম্ভীর ।
পুনর্বার প্রভুরে জিজ্ঞাসে বিপ্র ধীর ॥ ১৮০ ॥

prabhu maunī hai' rahe samudra-gambhīra |
punarbāra prabhure jijñāse bipra dhīra || 180 ||

prabhu mauni hai rahe — the Lord stays silent; samudra-gambhira — deep as the ocean; punarbara prabhure — again the Lord; jijnase vipra dhira — the grave brahmana asks

180The Lord stays silent, deep as the ocean;
again the grave brahmana asks the Lord:

তোর মাতা পিতা কে বা কহ না আমারে ।
প্রভু কহে সত্য এই তুমি যে কহিলে ॥ ১৮১ ॥

tora mātā pitā ke bā kaha nā āmāre |
prabhu kahe satya ei tumi ye kahile || 181 ||

tora mata pita ke va — who are Your mother and father; kaha na amare — do tell me; prabhu kahe — the Lord says; satya ei tumi ye kahile — what you said is true

181"Who are Your mother and father? Tell me."
The Lord says, "What you have said is true."

ভট্টাচার্য পুনর্বার তথাপি জিজ্ঞাসে ।
কহিবে তোমার কোথা হইল সন্ন্যাসে ॥ ১৮২ ॥

bhaṭṭācārya punarbāra tathāpi jijñāse |
kahibe tomāra kothā haila sannyāse || 182 ||

bhattacharya punarbara — the Bhattacharya again; tathapi jijnase — still asks; kahibe — tell; tomara kotha haila sannyase — where did You take sannyasa

182The Bhattacharya asks yet again,
"Tell me, where did You take sannyasa?"

প্রভু কহে এই সত্য জানিবে নিশ্চয় ।
শুনি' সার্বভৌম মনে বড়ই বিস্ময় ॥ ১৮৩ ॥

prabhu kahe ei satya jānibe niścaẏa |
śuni' sārbabhauma mane baṛai bismaẏa || 183 ||

prabhu kahe — the Lord says; ei satya janibe nishchaya — know for certain this is true; shuni — hearing; sarvabhauma mane badai vismaya — Sarvabhauma was greatly amazed

183The Lord says, "Know for certain: this is true."
Hearing this, Sarvabhauma was greatly amazed.

বুঝিতে নারিল কিছু প্রভুর নির্ণয় ।
কোটি-সরস্বতীকান্ত অখিলের জয় ॥ ১৮৪ ॥

bujhite nārila kichu prabhura nirṇaẏa |
koṭi-sarasbatīkānta akhilera jaẏa || 184 ||

bujhite narila kichhu — could not at all understand; prabhura nirnaya — the Lord's resolve; koti-sarasvati-kanta — the Lord of myriad Sarasvatis; akhilera jaya — the victory of all

184He could not at all understand the Lord's resolve —
the Lord of myriad Sarasvatis, the victory of all.11

কিবা বা ঈশ্বর কিবা বাতুল-স্বভাব ।
মনে কুণ্ঠা-ক্রোধ মাত্র হৈল তার লাভ ॥ ১৮৫ ॥

kibā bā īśbara kibā bātula-sbabhāba |
mane kuṇṭhā-krodha mātra haila tāra lābha || 185 ||

kiba va ishvara — whether God; kiba vatula-svabhava — or of a madman's nature; mane kuntha-krodha — vexation and anger in the mind; matra haila tara labha — was all he gained

185"Is He God — or of a madman's nature?"
Only vexation and anger fell to his lot.

আনাইল ভট্টাচার্য অনেক প্রসাদ ।
উঠিলা প্রসাদ দেখি' প্রেমার উন্মাদ ॥ ১৮৬ ॥

ānāila bhaṭṭācārya aneka prasāda |
uṭhilā prasāda dekhi' premāra unmāda || 186 ||

anaila bhattacharya — the Bhattacharya had brought; aneka prasada — much prasada; uthila — arose; prasada dekhi — at the sight of prasada; premara unmada — the madness of prema

186The Bhattacharya had much prasada brought;
at the sight of prasada the madness of prema arose.

জগন্নাথ-অন্ন-মহাপ্রসাদ পাইয়া ।
মস্তকে বন্দিলা প্রভু হাসিয়া হাসিয়া ॥ ১৮৭ ॥

jagannātha-anna-mahāprasāda pāiẏā |
mastake bandilā prabhu hāsiẏā hāsiẏā || 187 ||

jagannatha-anna-mahaprasada — Jagannatha's rice mahaprasada; paiya — receiving; mastake bandila prabhu — the Lord honoured it on His head; hasiya hasiya — laughing

187Receiving the mahaprasada — Jagannatha's rice —
the Lord, laughing, reverently raised it to His head.

হুঙ্কার করিল এক গম্ভীর শবদে ।
ব্রহ্মাণ্ড ভরিল সেই প্রভু-সিংহনাদে ॥ ১৮৮ ॥

huṅkāra karila eka gambhīra śabade |
brahmāṇḍa bharila sei prabhu-siṃhanāde || 188 ||

hunkara karila eka — gave a roar; gambhira shabade — with a deep sound; brahmanda bharila — filled the universe; sei prabhu-simhanade — that lion's roar of the Lord

188He gave a roar in a deep voice —
that lion's roar of the Lord filled the universe.

দেব, গন্ধর্ব, নর, শৃগাল, কুকুর ।
আইলা গৌরাঙ্গ-কাছে যত নাগকুল ॥ ১৮৯ ॥

deba, gandharba, nara, śṛgāla, kukura |
āilā gaurāṅga-kāche yata nāgakula || 189 ||

deva, gandharva, nara — gods, gandharvas, men; shrigala, kukura — jackals, dogs; aila gauranga-kachhe — came to Gauranga; yata nagakula — all the naga clans

189Gods, gandharvas, men, jackals, dogs
and all the clans of the nagas came to Gauranga.

সভার মুখেতে সেই প্রসাদ আনন্দে ।
দেখে গদাধর আদি প্রভু নিত্যানন্দে ॥ ১৯০ ॥

sabhāra mukhete sei prasāda ānande |
dekhe gadādhara ādi prabhu nityānande || 190 ||

sabhara mukhete — into the mouths of all; sei prasada anande — that prasada joyfully; dekhe gadadhara adi — Gadadhara and the others see; prabhu nityanande — and Prabhu Nityananda

190[He] joyfully put that prasada into all their mouths —
Gadadhara and the others and Prabhu Nityananda saw it.

কেহো না কহিল কিছু তত্ত্ব সব জানে ।
প্রসাদ পাইল সব লঞা ভক্তগণে ॥ ১৯১ ॥

keho nā kahila kichu tattba saba jāne |
prasāda pāila saba lañā bhaktagaṇe || 191 ||

keho na kahila kichhu — no one said anything; tattva saba jane — all know the truth; prasada paila saba — all received prasada; lanya bhakta-gane — with the devotees

191No one said anything: all knew the truth.
All received prasada together with the devotees.

নিজজন-সঙ্গে অল্প করিল ভোজন ।
হেনকালে শ্রীনিবাস কহিল বচন ॥ ১৯২ ॥

nijajana-saṅge alpa karila bhojana |
henakāle śrīnibāsa kahila bacana || 192 ||

nijajana-sange — with His own people; alpa karila bhojana — ate a little; henakale — then; shrinivasa kahila vachana — Srinivasa spoke

192He ate a little with His own people;
then Srinivasa spoke:

এক নিবেদিয়ে প্রভু কহিতে ডরাঙ ।
নির্ভয়ে পুছিয়ে প্রভু যদি আজ্ঞা পাঙ ॥ ১৯৩ ॥

eka nibediẏe prabhu kahite ḍarāṅa |
nirbhaẏe puchiẏe prabhu yadi ājñā pāṅa || 193 ||

eka nivediye — I have a request; prabhu kahite darang — Lord, I fear to say it; nirbhaye puchhiye — I shall ask without fear; prabhu yadi ajna pang — Lord, if I get leave

193"I have a request, Lord, but I am afraid to say it;
I shall ask without fear, if I have Your leave.

প্রসাদ পাইয়া তুমি হাসিলা যেকালে ।
চকিত দেখিল ইহা কহিবে আমারে ॥ ১৯৪ ॥

prasāda pāiẏā tumi hāsilā yekāle |
cakita dekhila ihā kahibe āmāre || 194 ||

prasada paiya — receiving prasada; tumi hasila yekale — when You laughed; chakita dekhila — I was startled to see; iha kahibe amare — tell me about this

194When You received the prasada and laughed,
I was startled to see it. Explain this to me."

এ বোল শুনিঞা প্রভু অধিক উল্লাস ।
কহয়ে অন্তর-কথা করিয়া প্রকাশ ॥ ১৯৫ ॥

e bola śuniñā prabhu adhika ullāsa |
kahaẏe antara-kathā kariẏā prakāśa || 195 ||

e bola shuninya — hearing this; prabhu adhika ullasa — the Lord in great joy; kahaye antara-katha — speaks of the inner matter; kariya prakasha — revealing it

195Hearing this, the Lord, in great joy,
speaks, revealing what is hidden:

কাত্যায়নী-প্রতিজ্ঞায় প্রসাদ হেন ধন ।
শৃগাল কুকুরে খায় শুনহ ব্রাহ্মণ ॥ ১৯৬ ॥

kātyāẏanī-pratijñāẏa prasāda hena dhana |
śṛgāla kukure khāẏa śunaha brāhmaṇa || 196 ||

katyayani-pratijnaya — by Katyayani's vow; prasada hena dhana — such a treasure as prasada; shrigala kukure khaya — jackals and dogs eat; shunaha brahmana — listen, brahmana

196"By Katyayani's vow, such a treasure as prasada
is eaten by jackals and dogs — listen, brahmana.12

ইন্দ্র, চন্দ্র, গন্ধর্ব কিবা দেবগণে ।
সভার দুর্লভ বস্তু না পায় যতনে ॥ ১৯৭ ॥

indra, candra, gandharba kibā debagaṇe |
sabhāra durlabha bastu nā pāẏa yatane || 197 ||

indra, chandra, gandharva — Indra, Chandra, the gandharvas; kiba deva-gane — or the gods; sabhara durlabha vastu — a thing rare for all; na paya yatane — not obtained by effort

197Indra, Chandra, the gandharvas or the gods —
for all it is a rarity: not to be had even by effort.

নারদ-প্রহ্লাদ-শুক-আদি ভক্তগণ ।
তাহার দুর্লভ এই কহিল মরম ॥ ১৯৮ ॥

nārada-prahlāda-śuka-ādi bhaktagaṇa |
tāhāra durlabha ei kahila marama || 198 ||

narada-prahlada-shuka-adi — Narada, Prahlada, Shuka and other; bhakta-gana — devotees; tahara durlabha ei — this is rare even for them; kahila marama — I have told the secret

198Narada, Prahlada, Shuka and the other devotees —
even for them it is rare: I have told you the secret.

হেন মহাপ্রসাদ ভুঞ্জয়ে সর্বজনে ।
কহিল মরম-কথা এই মোর মনে ॥ ১৯৯ ॥

hena mahāprasāda bhuñjaẏe sarbajane |
kahila marama-kathā ei mora mane || 199 ||

hena mahaprasada — such mahaprasada; bhunjaye sarvajane — all are eating; kahila marama-katha — I have told the secret; ei mora mane — this in My heart

199Such mahaprasada all are eating —
that is the secret I have told you, what was in My heart.

হেন মহাপ্রসাদ পাইয়া যে বা জন ।
অন্নবুদ্ধি করিয়া বা না করে ভক্ষণ ॥ ২০০ ॥

hena mahāprasāda pāiẏā ye bā jana |
annabuddhi kariẏā bā nā kare bhakṣaṇa || 200 ||

hena mahaprasada paiya — receiving such mahaprasada; ye va jana — whoever; anna-buddhi kariya va — taking it for ordinary food, or; na kare bhakshana — does not eat it

200Whoever, having received such mahaprasada,
takes it for ordinary food or does not eat it —

পূর্বজন্মার্জিত তার আছিল যে ধর্ম ।
সেহো নষ্ট হয় — সে শূকর-যোনি-জন্ম ॥ ২০১ ॥

pūrbajanmārjita tāra āchila ye dharma |
seho naṣṭa haẏa — se śūkara-yoni-janma || 201 ||

purva-janmarjita — earned in former births; tara achhila ye dharma — whatever dharma he had; seho nashta haya — that too perishes; se shukara-yoni-janma — he takes birth from a sow's womb

201even the dharma he gathered in former births perishes,
and he is born from the womb of a sow.

কুকুরের মুখ হৈতে পড়ে যদি তভু ।
পাইলে মাত্র খাবে ইথে দোষ নাহি কভু ॥ ২০২ ॥

kukurera mukha haite paṛe yadi tabhu |
pāile mātra khābe ithe doṣa nāhi kabhu || 202 ||

kukurera mukha haite — from a dog's mouth; pade yadi tabhu — even if it falls; paile matra khabe — eat as soon as you get it; ithe dosha nahi kabhu — there is no fault in this at all

202Even if [prasada] falls from a dog's mouth,
eat it as soon as you get it — there is no fault in this at all."13

তবে মহাপ্রভু ভিক্ষা করিল সাদরে ।
সন্ধ্যাকালে যায় জগন্নাথ দেখিবারে ॥ ২০৩ ॥

tabe mahāprabhu bhikṣā karila sādare |
sandhyākāle yāẏa jagannātha dekhibāre || 203 ||

tabe mahaprabhu — then Mahaprabhu; bhiksha karila sadare — reverently accepted alms; sandhyakale yaya — in the evening goes; jagannatha dekhibare — to see Jagannatha

203Then Mahaprabhu reverently accepted the alms
and in the evening goes to see Jagannatha.

শ্রীমন্দিরে প্রবেশিয়া দেখয়ে শ্রীমুখ ।
ব্রহ্মাণ্ডে না ধরে তার অন্তর-কৌতুক ॥ ২০৪ ॥

śrīmandire prabeśiẏā dekhaẏe śrīmukha |
brahmāṇḍe nā dhare tāra antara-kautuka || 204 ||

shri-mandire praveshiya — entering the temple; dekhaye shri-mukha — He sees the beautiful face; brahmande na dhare — the universe cannot hold; tara antara-kautuka — His inner delight

204Entering the temple, He sees the beautiful face;
the universe cannot contain His inner delight.

ধূপ দীপ সুকুসুম মনোহর গন্ধ ।
নিবেদন কৈল বিপ্র দেখিয়া আনন্দ ॥ ২০৪+১ ॥

dhūpa dīpa sukusuma manohara gandha |
nibedana kaila bipra dekhiẏā ānanda || 204+1 ||

dhupa dipa sukusuma — incense, lamps, lovely flowers; manohara gandha — enchanting fragrance; nivedana kaila vipra — the brahmana offered; dekhiya ananda — seeing [His] bliss

204+1Incense, lamps, lovely flowers, enchanting fragrance
the brahmana offered, seeing [His] bliss.

ঝলমল তেজ দেখি' অঙ্গের ছটাক ।
একত্র হইল যেন চাঁদ লাখে লাখ ॥ ২০৪+২ ॥

jhalamala teja dekhi' aṅgera chaṭāka |
ekatra haila yena cāṁda lākhe lākha || 204+2 ||

jhalamala teja dekhi — seeing the dazzling light; angera chhataka — the splendour of the body; ekatra haila yena — as if gathered together; chanda lakhe lakha — moons by the hundred thousand

204+2Seeing the dazzling splendour of [Jagannatha's] body —
as if moons by the hundred thousand had gathered in one place —14

নূতন মেঘের জিনি' অঙ্গের কিরণ ।
তাহে অপরূপ দুই কমললোচন ॥ ২০৫ ॥

nūtana meghera jini' aṅgera kiraṇa |
tāhe aparūpa dui kamalalocana || 205 ||

nutana meghera jini — outshining a fresh cloud; angera kirana — the radiance of the body; tahe aparupa — in it wondrous; dui kamala-lochana — two lotus eyes

205the radiance of His body, outshining a fresh cloud,
and in it two wondrous lotus eyes,

দেখিয়া আনন্দ-সিন্ধু ডুবিলা ঠাকুর ।
ভূমিতে লুটায় — প্রেম বাড়িল প্রচুর ॥ ২০৬ ॥

dekhiẏā ānanda-sindhu ḍubilā ṭhākura |
bhūmite luṭāẏa — prema bāṛila pracura || 206 ||

dekhiya — seeing; ananda-sindhu dubila thakura — the Thakura plunged into an ocean of bliss; bhumite lutaya — rolls on the ground; prema badila prachura — prema grew immensely

206the Thakura plunged into an ocean of bliss;
He rolls on the ground, His prema grew immensely.

সুমেরু-পর্বত যেন দীঘল শরীর ।
ভূমে গড়াগড়ি যায় আনন্দে অথির ॥ ২০৭ ॥

sumeru-parbata yena dīghala śarīra |
bhūme gaṛāgaṛi yāẏa ānande athira || 207 ||

sumeru-parvata yena — like Mount Sumeru; dighala sharira — the long body; bhume gadagadi yaya — rolls on the ground; anande athira — restless with bliss

207His long body, like Mount Sumeru,
rolls on the ground, unable to contain the bliss.

গৌরাঙ্গ-কিরণে জগন্নাথ হৈলা গোরা ।
ভাবময় হৈল দেহ পরম বিভোরা ॥ ২০৮ ॥

gaurāṅga-kiraṇe jagannātha hailā gorā |
bhābamaẏa haila deha parama bibhorā || 208 ||

gauranga-kirane — by Gauranga's radiance; jagannatha haila gora — Jagannatha became golden; bhavamaya haila deha — the body became full of bhava; parama vibhora — utterly rapt

208By Gauranga's radiance Jagannatha became golden,
His body filled with bhava, utterly rapt.

গৌরময় বলরাম আর পাণ্ডাগণ ।
ভাবময় দেহ সভার হইল তখন ॥ ২০৯ ॥

gauramaẏa balarāma āra pāṇḍāgaṇa |
bhābamaẏa deha sabhāra haila takhana || 209 ||

gauramaya balarama — Balarama became golden; ara panda-gana — and the pandas; bhavamaya deha sabhara — the bodies of all full of bhava; haila takhana — became then

209Balarama too became golden, and the pandas;
the bodies of all were filled with bhava.

গৌরাঙ্গ তুলিয়া পাণ্ডা করিল আরতি ।
অচল-ব্রহ্মের কাছে সচল-মূরতি ॥ ২১০ ॥

gaurāṅga tuliẏā pāṇḍā karila ārati |
acala-brahmera kāche sacala-mūrati || 210 ||

gauranga tuliya — lifting Gauranga; panda karila arati — a panda performed arati; achala-brahmera kachhe — beside the unmoving Brahman; sachala-murati — the moving form

210They raised Gauranga up, and a panda performed arati:
beside the unmoving Brahman — the moving form.15

জগন্নাথ প্রকাশ হইলা ন্যাসিরূপে ।
হেন অপরূপ না দেখিল কারো বাপে ॥ ২১১ ॥

jagannātha prakāśa hailā nyāsirūpe |
hena aparūpa nā dekhila kāro bāpe || 211 ||

jagannatha prakasha haila — Jagannatha appeared; nyasi-rupe — in the form of a sannyasi; hena aparupa — such a wonder; na dekhila karo bape — no one's father ever saw (no one ever saw)

211Jagannatha appeared in the form of a sannyasi —
such a wonder no one had ever seen.

তবে চিত্তে সম্বেদন হৈল কথোক্ষণে ।
আপন আশ্রমে গেলা নিজজন-সনে ॥ ২১২ ॥

tabe citte sambedana haila kathokṣaṇe |
āpana āśrame gelā nijajana-sane || 212 ||

tabe chitte samvedana haila — then He regained consciousness; kathokshane — after a while; apana ashrame gela — went to His lodging; nijajana-sane — with His own people

212After a while He came to Himself
and returned to His lodging with His own people.

এইমতে জগন্নাথ দেখি' তিনবার ।
দিবারাত্রি না জানয়ে আনন্দ-পাথার ॥ ২১৩ ॥

eimate jagannātha dekhi' tinabāra |
dibārātri nā jānaẏe ānanda-pāthāra || 213 ||

eimate — thus; jagannatha dekhi tinabara — seeing Jagannatha three times; divaratri na janaye — knows not day or night; ananda-pathara — an ocean of bliss

213Thus, seeing Jagannatha three times [a day],
He knows neither day nor night — an ocean of bliss.

হেনমতে নিজজন-সনে কথো দিন ।
কৌতুকে গোঙায় প্রভু প্রেম-প্রবীণ ॥ ২১৪ ॥

henamate nijajana-sane katho dina |
kautuke goṅāẏa prabhu prema-prabīṇa || 214 ||

henamate — thus; nijajana-sane — with His own people; katho dina — some days; kautuke gongaya prabhu — the Lord joyfully spends; prema-pravina — expert in prema

214Thus the Lord, expert in prema, spends some days
joyfully with His own people.

হেনই সময়ে কথা শুন সাবধানে ।
পুরুষোত্তমে প্রথম-প্রকাশ যেনমনে ॥ ২১৫ ॥

henai samaẏe kathā śuna sābadhāne |
puruṣottame prathama-prakāśa yenamane || 215 ||

henai samaye — now; katha shuna savadhane — hear the story carefully; purushottame — at Purushottama; prathama-prakasha yenamate — how He first revealed Himself

215Now hear carefully the story
of how He first revealed Himself at Purushottama.

লোকশিক্ষা করে প্রভু হঞা অকিঞ্চন ।
না বুঝি' মানুষ-জ্ঞান করে মূঢ়জন ॥ ২১৬ ॥

lokaśikṣā kare prabhu hañā akiñcana |
nā bujhi' mānuṣa-jñāna kare mūṛhajana || 216 ||

loka-shiksha kare prabhu — the Lord teaches the people; hanya akinchana — having become destitute; na bujhi — not understanding; manusha-jnana kare mudha-jana — fools think Him a man

216The Lord teaches the people, having become destitute;
not understanding this, fools take Him for a man.

সমুদ্র-ভিতরে টোটা করি' গৌররায় ।
নিজজন-সঙ্গে তাহাঁ নিজগুণ গায় ॥ ২১৭ ॥

samudra-bhitare ṭoṭā kari' gaurarāẏa |
nijajana-saṅge tāhāṁ nijaguṇa gāẏa || 217 ||

samudra-bhitare — by the sea; tota kari gauraraya — Gaura Raya made a garden; nijajana-sange — with His own people; tahan nijaguna gaya — there sings His own virtues

217By the sea Gaura Raya made Himself a garden
and there with His own people sings His own virtues.16

বিদ্যা-বিমোহিত-চিত্ত সার্বভৌম ।
প্রভুর পরোক্ষে কিছু কহিল বিভ্রম ॥ ২১৮ ॥

bidyā-bimohita-citta sārbabhauma |
prabhura parokṣe kichu kahila bibhrama || 218 ||

vidya-vimohita-chitta — his mind deluded by learning; sarvabhauma — Sarvabhauma; prabhura parokshe — behind the Lord's back; kichhu kahila vibhrama — spoke something mistaken

218Sarvabhauma, his mind deluded by learning,
said something mistaken about the Lord behind His back.

ব্রাহ্মণ-সজ্জন যত সম্পূর্ণ সভায় ।
তার মধ্যে কহে দ্বিজ যে ছিল হিয়ায় ॥ ২১৯ ॥

brāhmaṇa-sajjana yata sampūrṇa sabhāẏa |
tāra madhye kahe dbija ye chila hiẏāẏa || 219 ||

brahmana-sajjana yata — brahmanas and worthy men; sampurna sabhaya — in a full assembly; tara madhye — among them; kahe dvija ye chhila hiyaya — the brahmana says what was in his heart

219In an assembly full of brahmanas and worthy men,
that brahmana spoke what was in his heart:

মহাবংশে জন্ম ন্যাসী সুপণ্ডিত জন ।
তরুণ-বয়সে নহে সন্ন্যাস-করণ ॥ ২২০ ॥

mahābaṃśe janma nyāsī supaṇḍita jana |
taruṇa-baẏase nahe sannyāsa-karaṇa || 220 ||

maha-vamshe janma — born in a great family; nyasi supandita jana — the sannyasi, a fine scholar; taruna-vayase — at a young age; nahe sannyasa-karana — taking sannyasa is not [proper]

220"This sannyasi is of a noble family, a great scholar;
but it is not proper to take sannyasa at a young age.

এ সময়ে অনুচিত সন্ন্যাসের ধর্ম ।
না বুঝিয়া কৈল দ্বিজ এত বড় কর্ম ॥ ২২১ ॥

e samaẏe anucita sannyāsera dharma |
nā bujhiẏā kaila dbija eta baṛa karma || 221 ||

e samaye — at this time; anuchita sannyasera dharma — the dharma of sannyasa is improper; na bujhiya — not understanding; kaila dvija eta bada karma — the brahmana did such a deed

221At this time of life the dharma of sannyasa is unfitting;
not understanding this, the brahmana has done such a thing.

পুনরপি সংস্কার করু আপনার ।
বেদান্ত শিখিয়া করু আশ্রম-আচার ॥ ২২২ ॥

punarapi saṃskāra karu āpanāra |
bedānta śikhiẏā karu āśrama-ācāra || 222 ||

punarapi samskara karu — let Him again undergo the purificatory rites; apanara — His own; vedanta shikhiya — having learned Vedanta; karu ashrama-achara — let Him keep the rule of an ashrama

222Let Him undergo His purificatory rites again,
learn Vedanta and keep the rule of an ashrama.

সন্ন্যাসীর ধর্ম নহে কীর্তন-নর্তন ।
বেদান্ত আমার ঠাঞি করুক শ্রবণ ॥ ২২৩ ॥

sannyāsīra dharma nahe kīrtana-nartana |
bedānta āmāra ṭhāñi karuka śrabaṇa || 223 ||

sannyasira dharma nahe — it is not a sannyasi's dharma; kirtana-nartana — kirtana and dancing; vedanta amara thani — Vedanta from me; karuka shravana — let Him hear

223Kirtana and dancing are not a sannyasi's dharma;
let Him hear Vedanta from me."17

জগন্নাথ যতবার করয়ে ভোজন ।
ততবার সন্ন্যাসী সে করয়ে ভক্ষণ ॥ ২২৩+১ ॥

jagannātha yatabāra karaẏe bhojana |
tatabāra sannyāsī se karaẏe bhakṣaṇa || 223+1 ||

jagannatha yatabara — as many times as Jagannatha; karaye bhojana — eats; tatabara sannyasi se — so many times that sannyasi; karaye bhakshana — eats

223+1"As many times as Jagannatha eats,
so many times this sannyasi eats too.

যুবাকালে এত ভক্ষণ যে জন করয় ।
তার কাম-নিবৃত্তি কেমন-মতে হয় ॥ ২২৩+২ ॥

yubākāle eta bhakṣaṇa ye jana karaẏa |
tāra kāma-nibṛtti kemana-mate haẏa || 223+2 ||

yubakale — in youth; eta bhakshana ye jana karaya — whoever eats so much; tara kama-nivritti — the cessation of his lust; kemana-mate haya — how can it come about

223+2One who eats so much in youth —
how can his lust ever subside?

ঘর মনে পড়ে তেঞি রাধা বলি' কান্দে ।
বিপাকে পড়িলা ন্যাসী সন্ন্যাসের ফান্দে ॥ ২২৩+৩ ॥

ghara mane paṛe teñi rādhā bali' kānde |
bipāke paṛilā nyāsī sannyāsera phānde || 223+3 ||

ghara mane pade — he remembers home; tenni radha bali kande — so he weeps crying "Radha!"; vipake padila nyasi — to his misfortune the sannyasi fell; sannyasera phande — into the noose of sannyasa

223+3He remembers home — and weeps, 'Radha!'
To his misfortune the sannyasi has fallen into the noose of sannyasa."

এথা গোরাচাঁদ আছে নিজজন-সঙ্গে ।
কৃষ্ণকথা-আলাপনে প্রেম-পরসঙ্গে ॥ ২২৩+৪ ॥

ethā gorācāṁda āche nijajana-saṅge |
kṛṣṇakathā-ālāpane prema-parasaṅge || 223+4 ||

etha gorachanda achhe — meanwhile Gorachand is; nijajana-sange — with His own people; krishna-katha-alapane — in talks about Krishna; prema-parasange — in conversation on prema

223+4Meanwhile Gorachand was with His own people
in talks about Krishna, in conversation on prema.18

আচম্বিতে মুচকি হাসিলা গোরা পঁহু ।
অবিরল-ধারে যেন বরিখয়ে মহু ॥ ২২৪ ॥

ācambite mucaki hāsilā gorā paṁhu |
abirala-dhāre yena barikhaẏe mahu || 224 ||

achambite — suddenly; muchaki hasila gora panhu — Gora Panhu smiled faintly; avirala-dhare — in unbroken streams; yena barikhaye mahu — as if honey rained down

224Suddenly Gora Panhu smiled faintly —
as if honey had poured down in unbroken streams.

জানিঞা সকল পঁহু চলিলা তথায় ।
সার্বভৌম বসি' যথা বেদান্ত পঢ়ায় ॥ ২২৫ ॥

jāniñā sakala paṁhu calilā tathāẏa |
sārbabhauma basi' yathā bedānta paṛhāẏa || 225 ||

janinya sakala — knowing everything; panhu chalila tathaya — the Lord went there; sarvabhauma basi yatha — where Sarvabhauma sits; vedanta padhaya — teaching Vedanta

225Knowing everything, the Lord went there
where Sarvabhauma sits teaching Vedanta.

নিজজন-সনে সেইখানে উপনীত ।
দেখি' ভট্টাচার্য উঠে চমকিত-চিত ॥ ২২৬ ॥

nijajana-sane seikhāne upanīta |
dekhi' bhaṭṭācārya uṭhe camakita-cita || 226 ||

nijajana-sane — with His own people; seikhane upanita — arrived there; dekhi bhattacharya uthe — seeing, the Bhattacharya rises; chamakita-chita — in alarm

226He came there with His own people;
seeing Him, the Bhattacharya rose in alarm.

বসিতে আসন দিল সগৌরব-বাণী ।
ঠাকুর মাগয়ে বিধি — কি করিব আমি ॥ ২২৭ ॥

basite āsana dila sagauraba-bāṇī |
ṭhākura māgaẏe bidhi — ki kariba āmi || 227 ||

vasite asana dila — offered a seat; sagaurava-vani — with respectful words; thakura magaye vidhi — the Thakura asks for guidance; ki kariba ami — what should I do

227He offered Him a seat with respectful words,
and the Thakura asks him for guidance: "What should I do?

তুমি সার্বভৌম ভট্টাচার্য সব জান ।
অন্তরে পুছিয়ে তোরে কহ ত বিধান ॥ ২২৮ ॥

tumi sārbabhauma bhaṭṭācārya saba jāna |
antare puchiẏe tore kaha ta bidhāna || 228 ||

tumi sarvabhauma bhattacharya — you, Sarvabhauma Bhattacharya; saba jana — know everything; antare puchhiye tore — I ask you from My heart; kaha ta vidhana — tell Me the rule

228You, Sarvabhauma Bhattacharya, know everything;
I ask you from My heart — tell Me the rule.

সন্ন্যাস-আশ্রম-ধর্ম না বুঝিয়ে আমি ।
সন্ন্যাস করিল বিধি বিচারহ তুমি ॥ ২২৯ ॥

sannyāsa-āśrama-dharma nā bujhiẏe āmi |
sannyāsa karila bidhi bicāraha tumi || 229 ||

sannyasa-ashrama-dharma — the dharma of the sannyasa ashrama; na bujhiye ami — I do not understand; sannyasa karila — [I] took sannyasa; vidhi vicharaha tumi — you judge by the rule

229I do not understand the dharma of the sannyasa ashrama;
I have taken sannyasa — you judge what the law requires.

তুমি সর্বতত্ত্ববেত্তা বেদান্ত বাখান ।
কি বিধান আছে কিছু পঢ়াহ এখন ॥ ২৩০ ॥

tumi sarbatattbabettā bedānta bākhāna |
ki bidhāna āche kichu paṛhāha ekhana || 230 ||

tumi sarva-tattva-vetta — you know all truths; vedanta bakhana — you expound Vedanta; ki vidhana achhe — what rule is there; kichhu padhaha ekhana — teach [Me] now

230You know all truths, you expound Vedanta —
what is the rule? Teach Me now.

তরুণ বয়সে নহে সন্ন্যাসের ধর্ম ।
কি বিধান আছে পুনঃ উপবীত-কর্ম ॥ ২৩১ ॥

taruṇa baẏase nahe sannyāsera dharma |
ki bidhāna āche punaḥ upabīta-karma || 231 ||

taruna vayase — at a young age; nahe sannyasera dharma — the dharma of sannyasa is not proper; ki vidhana achhe — what is enjoined; punah upavita-karma — the sacred-thread rite again

231At a young age the dharma of sannyasa is not proper:
what is enjoined — to undergo the sacred-thread rite again?

জগন্নাথ-প্রসাদে মত্ত মোরে করাইল ।
কাম শান্তি করিবারে নারি যুবাকালে ॥ ২৩১+১ ॥

jagannātha-prasāde matta more karāila |
kāma śānti karibāre nāri yubākāle || 231+1 ||

jagannatha-prasade — Jagannatha's prasada; matta more karaila — has made Me drunk; kama shanti karibare — to quell lust; nari yubakale — I cannot in youth

231+1Jagannatha's prasada has made Me drunk,
and in youth I cannot quell My lust.

ঘর মনে পড়ে তেঞি কান্দি রাধা বলি' ।
কীর্তনের মাঝে তেঞি হইয়ে বিকলি ॥ ২৩১+২ ॥

ghara mane paṛe teñi kāndi rādhā bali' |
kīrtanera mājhe teñi haiẏe bikali || 231+2 ||

ghara mane pade — I remember home; tenni kandi radha bali — so I weep crying "Radha!"; kirtanera majhe — in the midst of kirtana; tenni haiye vikali — so I am beside Myself

231+2I remember home — and weep, saying 'Radha!' —
that is why in the midst of kirtana I am beside Myself."19

এ বোল শুনিঞা সার্বভৌম ভট্টাচার্য ।
হৃদয় সঙ্কোচ কিছু গুণয়ে আশ্চর্য ॥ ২৩২ ॥

e bola śuniñā sārbabhauma bhaṭṭācārya |
hṛdaẏa saṅkoca kichu guṇaẏe āścarya || 232 ||

e bola shuninya — hearing this; sarvabhauma bhattacharya — Sarvabhauma Bhattacharya; hridaya sankocha kichhu — somewhat abashed at heart; gunaye ashcharya — wonders

232Hearing this, Sarvabhauma Bhattacharya
was abashed at heart and wonders:

এখনি কহিল কথা নিজশিষ্য-সনে ।
এ কথা সকল ন্যাসী জানিল কেমনে ॥ ২৩৩ ॥

ekhani kahila kathā nijaśiṣya-sane |
e kathā sakala nyāsī jānila kemane || 233 ||

ekhani kahila katha — just now I said this; nija-shishya-sane — with my disciples; e katha sakala — all this; nyasi janila kemane — how did the sannyasi know

233"Only just now I said this with my disciples —
how did this sannyasi come to know all this?"

মনে অনুমান করি' লজ্জায় পীড়িত ।
কিছু না কহিল হিয়ায় রহিল বিস্মিত ॥ ২৩৪ ॥

mane anumāna kari' lajjāẏa pīṛita |
kichu nā kahila hiẏāẏa rahila bismita || 234 ||

mane anumana kari — guessing in his mind; lajjaya pidita — tormented by shame; kichhu na kahila — said nothing; hiyaya rahila vismita — remained amazed at heart

234Guessing [the truth], tormented by shame,
he said nothing and remained in wonder.

তার পর দিনে প্রভু সার্বভৌম-ঘরে ।
নিজজন-সঙ্গে গেলা তাঁরে দেখিবারে ॥ ২৩৫ ॥

tāra para dine prabhu sārbabhauma-ghare |
nijajana-saṅge gelā tāṁre dekhibāre || 235 ||

tara para dine — the next day; prabhu sarvabhauma-ghare — the Lord to Sarvabhauma's house; nijajana-sange gela — went with His own people; tanre dekhibare — to see him

235The next day the Lord went with His own people
to Sarvabhauma's house to see him.

বেদান্ত পঢ়ায় সার্বভৌম ঘরে বসি' ।
বেদান্ত-সিদ্ধান্ত প্রভু পুছে হাসি' হাসি' ॥ ২৩৬ ॥

bedānta paṛhāẏa sārbabhauma ghare basi' |
bedānta-siddhānta prabhu puche hāsi' hāsi' || 236 ||

vedanta padhaya — teaches Vedanta; sarvabhauma ghare basi — Sarvabhauma, sitting at home; vedanta-siddhanta — about the conclusions of Vedanta; prabhu puchhe hasi hasi — the Lord asks, smiling

236Sarvabhauma, sitting at home, is teaching Vedanta;
the Lord, smiling, asks about the conclusions of Vedanta.

বেদান্ত-নিগূঢ় কথা পুছিল ঠাকুর ।
কৃষ্ণ-পাদাশ্রয়-কথা অমৃত-অঙ্কুর ॥ ২৩৭ ॥

bedānta-nigūṛha kathā puchila ṭhākura |
kṛṣṇa-pādāśraẏa-kathā amṛta-aṅkura || 237 ||

vedanta-nigudha katha — about the hidden meaning of Vedanta; puchhila thakura — the Thakura asked; krishna-padashraya-katha — about refuge at Krishna's feet; amrita-ankura — the sprout of nectar

237The Thakura asked about the hidden meaning of Vedanta —
about refuge at the feet of Krishna, the sprout of nectar.20

বেদে নরাকৃতি ব্রহ্ম শাস্ত্রে জানাইলে ।
তুমি তাহা নাহি মান আত্মবুদ্ধি-বলে ॥ ২৩৭+১ ॥

bede narākṛti brahma śāstre jānāile |
tumi tāhā nāhi māna ātmabuddhi-bale || 237+1 ||

vede — in the Veda; narakriti brahma — Brahman with a human-like form; shastre janaile — the shastras have declared; tumi taha nahi mana — you do not accept it; atma-buddhi-bale — by the force of your own mind

237+1"The Veda declares that Brahman has a form like a man's —
yet you do not accept this, relying on your own mind.

ব্রহ্মার বচন ব্রহ্মসংহিতাতে কহে ।
সচ্চিদানন্দময় সেই মহৈশ্বর্যময়ে ॥ ২৩৭+২ ॥

brahmāra bacana brahmasaṃhitāte kahe |
saccidānandamaẏa sei mahaiśbaryamaẏe || 237+2 ||

brahmara vachana — Brahma's word; brahma-samhitate kahe — says in the Brahma-samhita; sach-chid-ananda-maya — full of being, consciousness and bliss; sei mahaishvarya-maye — He, full of supreme majesty

237+2Brahma's word in the Brahma-samhita says:
He is eternal being, consciousness and bliss, full of supreme majesty;

রসময় দেহ তাঁর শ্যাম কলেবর ।
আর অবতার অংশ কৃষ্ণ পূর্ণবর ॥ ২৩৭+৩ ॥

rasamaẏa deha tāṁra śyāma kalebara |
āra abatāra aṃśa kṛṣṇa pūrṇabara || 237+3 ||

rasamaya deha tanra — His body made of rasa; shyama kalebara — a dark form; ara avatara amsha — the other avataras are portions; krishna purnavara — Krishna the complete, the highest

237+3His body is made of rasa, His form is dark;
the other avataras are portions — Krishna is the complete, the highest.

ভাগবতে এই কথা ব্যাস জানাইল ।
তুমি তাহা নষ্ট করি' আর মত বল ॥ ২৩৭+৪ ॥

bhāgabate ei kathā byāsa jānāila |
tumi tāhā naṣṭa kari' āra mata bala || 237+4 ||

bhagavate — in the Bhagavata; ei katha vyasa janaila — Vyasa declared this; tumi taha nashta kari — you, rejecting it; ara mata bala — teach another doctrine

237+4Vyasa declared this in the Bhagavata —
yet you reject it and teach another doctrine.

রাধা পূর্ণতত্ত্ববস্তু বরাহসংহিতা কহে ।
আর সব প্রকৃতি তাঁর নখজ্যোতি হয়ে ॥ ২৩৭+৫ ॥

rādhā pūrṇatattbabastu barāhasaṃhitā kahe |
āra saba prakṛti tāṁra nakhajyoti haẏe || 237+5 ||

radha purna-tattva-vastu — Radha is the complete truth; varaha-samhita kahe — the Varaha-samhita says; ara saba prakriti — all other prakritis; tanra nakha-jyoti haye — are the radiance of Her nails

237+5The Varaha-samhita says: Radha is the complete truth;
all other prakritis are the radiance of Her toenails.

গৌতমীয়তন্ত্র সনৎকুমারসংহিতা ।
রাধাতত্ত্ব তাহাতেই আছে বিরচিতা ॥ ২৩৭+৬ ॥

gautamīẏatantra sanatkumārasaṃhitā |
rādhātattba tāhātei āche biracitā || 237+6 ||

gautamiya-tantra — the Gautamiya-tantra; sanatkumara-samhita — the Sanatkumara-samhita; radha-tattva — the truth of Radha; tahatei achhe virachita — is set forth in them

237+6In the Gautamiya-tantra and the Sanatkumara-samhita
the truth of Radha is set forth.

বেদ-অর্থ শাস্ত্রে লেখে ব্যাস মুনিবর ।
ব্যাসনিন্দা করি' তুমি পাও কিবা ফল ॥ ২৩৭+৭ ॥

beda-artha śāstre lekhe byāsa munibara |
byāsanindā kari' tumi pāo kibā phala || 237+7 ||

veda-artha shastre lekhe — wrote the meaning of the Veda in the shastras; vyasa munivara — the sage Vyasa; vyasa-ninda kari — reviling Vyasa; tumi pao kiba phala — what fruit do you get

237+7The sage Vyasa wrote down the meaning of the Veda in the shastras:
what do you gain by reviling Vyasa?

বৃন্দাবন ধাম কৃষ্ণস্থান চিন্তামণি ।
বিহার করেন কৃষ্ণ সঙ্গেতে রমণী ॥ ২৩৭+৮ ॥

bṛndābana dhāma kṛṣṇasthāna cintāmaṇi |
bihāra karena kṛṣṇa saṅgete ramaṇī || 237+8 ||

vrindavana dhama — the abode of Vrindavana; krishna-sthana chintamani — Krishna's land of chintamani; vihara karena krishna — Krishna sports; sangete ramani — with His beloveds

237+8The abode of Vrindavana is Krishna's land of chintamani;
there Krishna sports with His beloveds.

রমণীর শিরোমণি রাধা মহাদেবী ।
মহাতত্ত্ব দেব কৃষ্ণ বেদে অনুভবি ॥ ২৩৭+৯ ॥

ramaṇīra śiromaṇi rādhā mahādebī |
mahātattba deba kṛṣṇa bede anubhabi || 237+9 ||

ramanira shiromani — the crown of the beloveds; radha mahadevi — Radha, the great goddess; maha-tattva deva krishna — the great truth, Lord Krishna; vede anubhavi — realized in the Vedas

237+9The crown of the beloveds is Radha, the great goddess;
the great truth is Lord Krishna, realized in the Vedas.

দোঁহার কীর্তন গায় যত গোপীগণ ।
সে কীর্তন নিন্দা কর তুমি সে অধম ॥ ২৩৭+১০ ॥

doṁhāra kīrtana gāẏa yata gopīgaṇa |
se kīrtana nindā kara tumi se adhama || 237+10 ||

donhara kirtana — the kirtana of the two; gaya yata gopi-gana — all the gopis sing; se kirtana ninda kara — you revile that kirtana; tumi se adhama — you are base

237+10The kirtana of the two is sung by all the gopis —
and you revile that kirtana: you are base.

কীর্তন-মহিমা-কথা ভাগবতে কয় ।
ব্রহ্মহত্যা আদি পাপ সব নষ্ট হয় ॥ ২৩৭+১১ ॥

kīrtana-mahimā-kathā bhāgabate kaẏa |
brahmahatyā ādi pāpa saba naṣṭa haẏa || 237+11 ||

kirtana-mahima-katha — of the glory of kirtana; bhagavate kaya — the Bhagavata speaks; brahma-hatya adi papa — the killing of a brahmana and other sins; saba nashta haya — all are destroyed

237+11The Bhagavata speaks of the glory of kirtana:
the killing of a brahmana and other sins — all are destroyed.

তেনমতে নাম বিনাশয় পাপগিরি ।
পাছে কৃষ্ণ পায় চিন্তামণি নাম ধরি' ॥ ২৩৭+১২ ॥

tenamate nāma bināśaẏa pāpagiri |
pāche kṛṣṇa pāẏa cintāmaṇi nāma dhari' || 237+12 ||

tenamate — likewise; nama vinashaya papagiri — the name destroys mountains of sin; pachhe krishna paya — afterwards [one] attains Krishna; chintamani nama dhari — [the name] bearing the name chintamani

237+12So the name destroys mountains of sin,
and then [one] attains Krishna: the name is called chintamani.

প্রসাদ পাইলে কোটি কোটি পাপ নাশে ।
তুমি কহ লোভ মোহ কামের প্রকাশে ॥ ২৩৭+১৩ ॥

prasāda pāile koṭi koṭi pāpa nāśe |
tumi kaha lobha moha kāmera prakāśe || 237+13 ||

prasada paile — on receiving prasada; koti koti papa nashe — millions of sins are destroyed; tumi kaha — you say; lobha moha kamera prakashe — [it is] a display of greed, delusion and lust

237+13Taste prasada, and millions of sins are destroyed —
yet you call it the display of greed, delusion and lust!

বৈষ্ণব-মহিমা সব শাস্ত্রের প্রমাণে ।
তুমি শাস্ত্র নাহি মান কোন্ শাস্ত্রজ্ঞানে ॥ ২৩৭+১৪ ॥

baiṣṇaba-mahimā saba śāstrera pramāṇe |
tumi śāstra nāhi māna kon śāstrajñāne || 237+14 ||

vaishnava-mahima — the glory of the Vaishnavas; saba shastrera pramane — on the evidence of all the shastras; tumi shastra nahi mana — you do not accept the shastras; kon shastra-jnane — with what knowledge of shastra

237+14The glory of the Vaishnavas is proved by all the shastras;
you do not accept the shastras — what knowledge of the shastras do you have?"21

শুনি' সার্বভৌম হৈলা বিস্মিত অন্তর ।
বুঝিল মনুষ্য নহে শচীর কোঙর ॥ ২৩৮ ॥

śuni' sārbabhauma hailā bismita antara |
bujhila manuṣya nahe śacīra koṅara || 238 ||

shuni — hearing; sarvabhauma haila vismita antara — Sarvabhauma was amazed at heart; bujhila — understood; manushya nahe shachira kongara — the son of Shachi is not a man

238Hearing this, Sarvabhauma was amazed at heart:
he understood that the son of Shachi is not a man.

লজ্জায় পীড়িত হৈলা হৃদয়ে তরাস ।
এতকাল নাহি শুনি এমত নির্যাস ॥ ২৩৯ ॥

lajjāẏa pīṛita hailā hṛdaẏe tarāsa |
etakāla nāhi śuni emata niryāsa || 239 ||

lajjaya pidita haila — tormented by shame; hridaye tarasa — fear in his heart; etakala nahi shuni — so long I have not heard; emata niryasa — such an essence

239Shame tormented him, fear was in his heart:
"In all these years I have never heard such an essence!

পড়িল শুনিল যত এতকাল ধরি' ।
পড়াইল শিষ্যগণে অহঙ্কার করি' ॥ ২৪০ ॥

paṛila śunila yata etakāla dhari' |
paṛāila śiṣyagaṇe ahaṅkāra kari' || 240 ||

padila shunila yata — all I read and heard; etakala dhari — through so many years; padaila shishya-gane — I taught the disciples; ahankara kari — with pride

240All that I have read and heard through so many years
I have taught my disciples with pride.

এখনে শুনিল এ বেদান্ত-সিদ্ধান্ত ।
এই মহাপ্রভু সেই সরস্বতী-কান্ত ॥ ২৪১ ॥

ekhane śunila e bedānta-siddhānta |
ei mahāprabhu sei sarasbatī-kānta || 241 ||

ekhane shunila — now I have heard; e vedanta-siddhanta — this conclusion of Vedanta; ei mahaprabhu — this Mahaprabhu; sei sarasvati-kanta — is that Lord of Sarasvati

241And now I have heard this conclusion of Vedanta:
this Mahaprabhu is the Lord of Sarasvati Himself."

এত অনুমানি' সার্বভৌম দ্বিজরাজ ।
করজোড়ে স্তুতি করে দেখিয়া সে কাজ ॥ ২৪২ ॥

eta anumāni' sārbabhauma dbijarāja |
karajoṛe stuti kare dekhiẏā se kāja || 242 ||

eta anumani — concluding thus; sarvabhauma dvijaraja — Sarvabhauma, king of brahmanas; karajode stuti kare — with joined palms offers praises; dekhiya se kaja — seeing this

242Concluding thus, Sarvabhauma, king of brahmanas,
with joined palms offers praises, seeing this.

হেনই সময়ে প্রভু ষড়ভুজ-শরীর ।
দেখি' সার্বভৌম হৈলা আনন্দে অস্থির ॥ ২৪৩ ॥

henai samaẏe prabhu ṣaṛabhuja-śarīra |
dekhi' sārbabhauma hailā ānande asthira || 243 ||

henai samaye — at that very moment; prabhu shadbhuja-sharira — the Lord, a six-armed form; dekhi — seeing; sarvabhauma haila anande asthira — Sarvabhauma lost composure in bliss

243At that very moment the Lord [showed] a six-armed form;
seeing it, Sarvabhauma lost all composure in bliss.

ঊর্ধ্ব দুই হাথে ধরে ধনু আর শর ।
মধ্য দুই হাথে ধরে মুরলী অধর ॥ ২৪৪ ॥

ūrdhba dui hāthe dhare dhanu āra śara |
madhya dui hāthe dhare muralī adhara || 244 ||

urdhva dui hathe — in the upper two hands; dhare dhanu ara shara — holds bow and arrow; madhya dui hathe — in the middle two hands; dhare murali adhara — holds the flute at the lips

244In the upper two hands He holds bow and arrow,
in the middle two the flute at His lips,

নম্র দুই হাথে ধরে দণ্ড কমণ্ডলু ।
দেখি' সার্বভৌম হৈলা আনন্দে বিহ্বল ॥ ২৪৫ ॥

namra dui hāthe dhare daṇḍa kamaṇḍalu |
dekhi' sārbabhauma hailā ānande bihbala || 245 ||

namra dui hathe — in the lower two hands; dhare danda kamandalu — holds staff and kamandalu; dekhi — seeing; sarvabhauma haila anande vihvala — Sarvabhauma was beside himself with bliss

245in the lower two the staff and the kamandalu.
Seeing this, Sarvabhauma was beside himself with bliss.22

চরণে পড়িয়া কান্দে বিনয় বিস্তর ।
স্তুতি করে সার্বভৌম গদগদ-স্বর ॥ ২৪৬ ॥

caraṇe paṛiẏā kānde binaẏa bistara |
stuti kare sārbabhauma gadagada-sbara || 246 ||

charane padiya kande — fallen at the feet, weeps; vinaya vistara — in great humility; stuti kare sarvabhauma — Sarvabhauma offers praises; gadagada-svara — in a choked voice

246Fallen at His feet, he weeps in great humility;
Sarvabhauma offers praises in a choked voice.

সগদগদ-স্বরে পঢ়ে সহস্রেক স্তব ।
চৈতন্যসহস্র নাম জানে লোক সব ॥ ২৪৭ ॥

sagadagada-sbare paṛhe sahasreka staba |
caitanyasahasra nāma jāne loka saba || 247 ||

sagadgada-svare — in a choked voice; padhe sahasreka stava — recites a thousand praises; chaitanya-sahasra nama — "the Thousand Names of Chaitanya"; jane loka saba — all people know

247In a choked voice he recites a thousand praises —
people know them as the "Thousand Names of Chaitanya."23

জয় রঘুবীর যদুবীর মহাশয় ।
জয় দ্বিজবীর গৌরসিংহ সর্বাশ্রয় ॥ ২৪৭+১ ॥

jaẏa raghubīra yadubīra mahāśaẏa |
jaẏa dbijabīra gaurasiṃha sarbāśraẏa || 247+1 ||

jaya raghuvira — glory to Raghuvira; yaduvira mahashaya — to Yaduvira, the Great One; jaya dvijavira — glory to the hero among brahmanas; gaura-simha sarvashraya — the Lion Gaura, refuge of all

247+1"Glory to Raghuvira, Yaduvira, the Great One!
Glory to the hero among brahmanas, the Lion Gaura, the refuge of all!

বিদ্যামদে মত্ত হৈয়া তোমা নিন্দা কৈনু ।
তোমার অভয় পদে মুঞি বিকাইনু ॥ ২৪৭+২ ॥

bidyāmade matta haiẏā tomā nindā kainu |
tomāra abhaẏa pade muñi bikāinu || 247+2 ||

vidya-made matta haiya — drunk with the pride of learning; toma ninda kainu — I reviled You; tomara abhaya pade — to Your fearless feet; muni bikainu — I have sold myself

247+2Drunk with the pride of learning I reviled You —
now I have sold myself to Your feet, which grant fearlessness.

অপরাধ ক্ষমা কর জয় গৌরহরি ।
পরম দয়ালু তুমি সভার উপরি ॥ ২৪৭+৩ ॥

aparādha kṣamā kara jaẏa gaurahari |
parama daẏālu tumi sabhāra upari || 247+3 ||

aparadha kshama kara — forgive the offence; jaya gaurahari — glory to Gaurahari; parama dayalu tumi — You are supremely merciful; sabhara upari — to all

247+3Forgive my offence! Glory to Gaurahari!
You are supremely merciful to all."

সার্বভৌমে কৃপা কৈল গৌর মহাসিংহ ।
আনন্দ বাড়িল সব ভক্ত-মহাভৃঙ্গ ॥ ২৪৭+৪ ॥

sārbabhaume kṛpā kaila gaura mahāsiṃha |
ānanda bāṛila saba bhakta-mahābhṛṅga || 247+4 ||

sarvabhaume kripa kaila — showed mercy to Sarvabhauma; gaura mahasimha — Gaura, the great lion; ananda badila — bliss grew; saba bhakta-mahabhringa — in all the devotees, great bees

247+4Gaura, the great lion, showed mercy to Sarvabhauma;
the bliss of all the devotees grew — great bees.24

বিহ্বল হইয়া পড়ে পাদাম্বুজ-পাশ ।
কহয়ে লোচন সার্বভৌমের প্রকাশ ॥ ২৪৮ ॥

bihbala haiẏā paṛe pādāmbuja-pāśa |
kahaẏe locana sārbabhaumera prakāśa || 248 ||

vihvala haiya — rapt; pade padambuja-pasha — falls at the lotus feet; kahaye lochana — Lochana tells; sarvabhaumera prakasha — of the revelation to Sarvabhauma

248Rapt, he falls at the lotus feet.
Lochana tells how [the Lord] revealed Himself to Sarvabhauma.

এইমতে আছে প্রভু আনন্দ-কৌতুকে ।
আনন্দে দেখয়ে নীলাচলবাসী লোকে ॥ ২৪৯ ॥

eimate āche prabhu ānanda-kautuke |
ānande dekhaẏe nīlācalabāsī loke || 249 ||

eimate achhe prabhu — thus the Lord stays; ananda-kautuke — in bliss and delight; anande dekhaye — joyfully behold; nilachala-basi loke — the people of Nilachala

249Thus the Lord stays in bliss and delight,
and the people of Nilachala behold Him with joy.

আছিল-অধিক জগন্নাথের প্রকাশ ।
সভার হৃদয়ে সুখ পরশে আকাশ ॥ ২৫০ ॥

āchila-adhika jagannāthera prakāśa |
sabhāra hṛdaẏe sukha paraśe ākāśa || 250 ||

achhila-adhika — more than before; jagannathera prakasha — the manifestation of Jagannatha; sabhara hridaye sukha — the happiness in everyone's heart; parashe akasha — touches the sky

250The glory of Jagannatha shone forth more than before;
in everyone's heart happiness touches the sky.

চৈতন্যচরিত-কথা কে কহিতে জানে ।
সম্বরিতে নারি কিছু কহিয়ে বদনে ॥ ২৫১ ॥

caitanyacarita-kathā ke kahite jāne |
sambarite nāri kichu kahiẏe badane || 251 ||

chaitanya-charita-katha — the story of Chaitanya's deeds; ke kahite jane — who knows how to tell; sambarite nari — I cannot hold back; kichhu kahiye badane — I tell a little with my lips

251Who knows how to tell the story of Chaitanya?
I cannot hold back — I tell a little with my lips.

শ্রীমুরারিগুপ্ত বেজা ধন্য তিনলোকে ।
পণ্ডিত শ্রীদামোদর পুছিল তাহাকে ॥ ২৫২ ॥

śrīmurārigupta bejā dhanya tinaloke |
paṇḍita śrīdāmodara puchila tāhāke || 252 ||

shri-murari-gupta beja — Sri Murari Gupta the vaidya; dhanya tina-loke — blessed in the three worlds; pandita shri-damodara — Pandita Sri Damodara; puchhila tahake — asked him

252Sri Murari Gupta the vaidya, blessed in the three worlds —
Pandita Sri Damodara asked him;

কহিল মুরারিগুপ্ত শ্লোক-প্রবন্ধে ।
যে কিছু শুনিল সেই দোঁহার প্রসাদে ॥ ২৫৩ ॥

kahila murārigupta śloka-prabandhe |
ye kichu śunila sei doṁhāra prasāde || 253 ||

kahila murari-gupta — Murari Gupta told; shloka-prabandhe — in a composition of verses; ye kichhu shunila — whatever I heard; sei donhara prasade — is by the grace of both

253Murari Gupta told it in verses —
what I have heard is by the grace of them both.25

শুনিঞা মাধুরী-লোভে চিত্ত উতরোলে ।
নিজদোষ না দেখিয়া মন ভোর ভেলে ॥ ২৫৪ ॥

śuniñā mādhurī-lobhe citta utarole |
nijadoṣa nā dekhiẏā mana bhora bhele || 254 ||

shuninya — hearing; madhuri-lobhe — in greed for the sweetness; chitta utarole — the heart was stirred; nija-dosha na dekhiya — not seeing my faults; mana bhora bhele — the mind was enraptured

254Hearing it, my heart was stirred with longing for its sweetness,
and, not seeing my own faults, my mind was enraptured.

যে কিছু কহিল নিজবুদ্ধি-অনুরূপ ।
পাঁচালী-প্রবন্ধে কহোঁ মো ছার মুরুখ ॥ ২৫৫ ॥

ye kichu kahila nijabuddhi-anurūpa |
pāṁcālī-prabandhe kahoṁ mo chāra murukha || 255 ||

ye kichhu kahila — whatever I told; nija-buddhi-anurupa — according to my own understanding; panchali-prabandhe kahon — I tell in a panchali composition; mo chhara murukha — I, a wretched fool

255What I have told according to my own understanding
I, a wretched fool, tell in a sung panchali.

সূত্রখণ্ড, আদিখণ্ড, মধ্যখণ্ড সায় ।
শেষখণ্ড আছে পুনঃ কহিব কথায় ॥ ২৫৬ ॥

sūtrakhaṇḍa, ādikhaṇḍa, madhyakhaṇḍa sāẏa |
śeṣakhaṇḍa āche punaḥ kahiba kathāẏa || 256 ||

sutrakhanda, adikhanda, madhyakhanda saya — the Sutra-, Adi- and Madhya-khanda are ended; sheshakhanda achhe punah — the Shesha-khanda remains; kahiba kathaya — I shall tell it in the story

256The Sutra-khanda, Adi-khanda and Madhya-khanda are ended;
the Shesha-khanda remains — I shall tell it in the story.

চৈতন্যচরিত্র-কথা চৈতন্য-প্রকাশ ।
মধ্যখণ্ড সায় কহে এ লোচনদাস ॥ ২৫৭ ॥

caitanyacaritra-kathā caitanya-prakāśa |
madhyakhaṇḍa sāẏa kahe e locanadāsa || 257 ||

chaitanya-charitra-katha — the story of Chaitanya's deeds; chaitanya-prakasha — the manifestation of Chaitanya; madhyakhanda saya — the Madhya-khanda is ended; kahe e lochanadasa — says this Lochana Dasa

257The story of Chaitanya's deeds is the manifestation of Chaitanya.
"The Madhya-khanda is ended," says this Lochana Dasa.

Thus ends the Madhya-khanda of the Sri Chaitanya-mangala, composed by Sri Lochana Dasa Thakura.26
